    ## Known limitations
    ## 6b. Обязательно при деплое
    - За nginx задать `CLIENT_IP_HEADER`. Иначе все клиенты получают IP прокси, и блокировка по «логин + IP» превращается в блокировку по логину: любой сможет заблокировать вход жюри.
    - Блокировки при одновременном редактировании работают только на PostgreSQL (SQLite их игнорирует).
    - nginx НЕ отдаёт папку `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT` (вложения к заявкам). Файлы скачиваются только через Django с проверкой доступа (TASK-006).
    - Сервер маленький (1 ядро, 1 ГБ): сначала swap 1 ГБ, потом установка пакетов.
    - Резервная копия: папку `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT` копировать вместе с базой. Иначе скачивание вложений после восстановления базы даст ошибку.
    - nginx: `client_max_body_size 20m` — иначе загрузка PDF к заявкам (до 3 файлов по 5 МБ) упадёт с ошибкой 413 (TASK-006).
    - Запустить `seed_demo` на сервере 22.11 (в день сдачи). Изменения расписания попадут на недели 16–22.11 и 23–29.11, то есть на весь период проверки жюри (23–28.11). Ежедневный cron не нужен.

    +# TASK-011: production readiness — gunicorn, nginx, systemd, PostgreSQL CI, deploy runbook
    +
    +Author: Planner. Status: ready for implementation (includes the Team lead's amendment: 1 vCPU / 1 GB RAM / 10 GB disk).
    +Base commit: `d9d8e55`. Related: `plan.md` 6b, `README.md` "Deployment notes", `config/settings.py`, `config/env_utils.py`, `accounts/throttling.py`.
    +
    +The agents have no server access. This task only adds files to the repository and documents the manual deployment. Target: Ubuntu 24.04, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk, one domain with HTTPS, until 2026-11-28.
    +
    +---
    +
    +## 1. Acceptance criteria
    +| ID | Criterion |
    +|---|---|
    +| AC1 | `gunicorn==26.2.0` in `requirements.txt`; `deploy/gunicorn.conf.py`: bind `127.0.0.1:8000` (env `GUNICORN_BIND`), workers from env `GUNICORN_WORKERS` (default 2), timeout 30, graceful timeout 30, access/error log to stdout/stderr (journal), control socket disabled. |
    +| AC2 | `deploy/nginx/deanery-bootstrap.conf` (HTTP only, for the first certificate) and `deploy/nginx/deanery.conf` (HTTP → HTTPS redirect, ACME path, TLS, proxy to `127.0.0.1:8000` with `Host`, `X-Real-IP`, `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `client_max_body_size 20m`, no `root`/`alias` except the ACME webroot, no static or private-media location, no headers that Django already sets). |
    +| AC3 | `deploy/systemd/deanery.service` (non-root `<APP_USER>`, `EnvironmentFile=/etc/deanery/deanery.env`, `Restart=on-failure`, hardening options); `deploy/journald/50-deanery.conf` (`SystemMaxUse=200M`); `deploy/backup.sh` (gzip `pg_dump` + tar of `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT`, keeps 7 days); `deploy/cron/deanery-backup`; `deploy/manage.sh` (runs `manage.py` with the env file); `deploy/ssh/10-deanery-hardening.conf`. |
    +| AC4 | `.env.production.example` lists every env variable the project reads (settings, management commands, gunicorn config) with a comment; `DEBUG=false`; `CLIENT_IP_HEADER=X-Real-IP` (matches nginx); PostgreSQL `DATABASE_URL`; `CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://example.com`; only placeholders. `check --deploy --fail-level WARNING` passes with exactly these values (test). |
    +| AC5 | CI job `test-postgres` with service `postgres:16` runs check, makemigrations check, the full suite, `run_tests_at.py`, migrate + seed twice on PostgreSQL; the SQLite job stays. CI also runs `gunicorn --check-config` and `bash -n deploy/*.sh`. |
    +| AC6 | `docs/DEPLOY.md` runbook (English, numbered, copy-paste commands) covering every step in section 4.9, including swap first, journald limit, resources section, trial vs final database, one-time `seed_demo` on 2026-11-22, HSTS raise procedure. `README.md` "Deployment notes" points to it. |
    +| AC7 | Tests (section 6): nginx template rules, env coverage, deploy check with example values, gunicorn config values, systemd unit rules, no secrets / real IPs in `deploy/`, `.env.production.example`, `docs/DEPLOY.md`, shell syntax. |
    +| AC8 | Any PostgreSQL-only failure found by the PostgreSQL run is fixed minimally and listed in the `REPORT`. |
    +
    +## 2. Out of scope
    +Logging in to the server, Docker/Kubernetes, CDN, monitoring, e-mail, the visual theme, changing Django security settings (only documentation of how to raise HSTS).
    +
    +## 3. Design decisions
    +**D1. gunicorn 26.2.0.** Released 2026-08-24, no runtime dependencies, Python ≥ 3.10. The newer 27.x line is one week old (27.0.0 on 2026-11-10, 27.0.1 on 2026-11-12) — too fresh for a deploy this week. Verified locally (9.6): `--check-config` passes, 2 workers boot, `/health/` → 200. Version 26 starts a "control server" in `$HOME/.gunicorn`; the config disables it (`control_socket_disable = True`), which also suits `ProtectHome=` in systemd.
    +
    +**D2. Workers.** Default 2 for 1 vCPU / 1 GB (each Django worker ≈ 60–90 MB RSS). Formula for a bigger server, documented in the config and the runbook: `workers = min(2 × vCPU + 1, (free RAM in MB − 300) / 90)`; set `GUNICORN_WORKERS` in the env file.
    +
    +**D3. Loopback TCP, not a Unix socket.** `127.0.0.1:8000` needs no shared group or socket permissions between `www-data` and the app user, which removes a common manual-setup error. The port is not reachable from outside (loopback only; ufw allows only 22/80/443). Because only nginx can reach gunicorn, Django may trust `X-Forwarded-Proto` (`SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER`) and `X-Real-IP` (`CLIENT_IP_HEADER`).
    +
    +**D4. Static files stay with WhiteNoise.** WhiteNoise already serves hashed, compressed files with far-future cache headers (`CompressedManifestStaticFilesStorage` when `DEBUG=false`). nginx then needs no `root` for the app at all, so it cannot serve any file of the project directory — in particular not `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT`. Cost on 1 vCPU is small for a prototype (static files are cached by browsers).
    +
    +**D5. Client IP header = `X-Real-IP`.** nginx sets `proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;` (overwrites any client value). `accounts/throttling.py` reads it directly. `X-Forwarded-For` is also passed (standard), but not used for throttling.
    +
    +**D6. Certificates: certbot webroot.** First a HTTP-only bootstrap config serves `/.well-known/acme-challenge/` from `/var/www/letsencrypt`; `certbot certonly --webroot` gets the certificate; then the full config is installed. Renewal uses the same webroot location (kept in the port-80 server) and the `certbot.timer` that the Ubuntu package installs; `--deploy-hook "systemctl reload nginx"` reloads nginx after renewal. The nginx config stays a tested file in the repo (the `--nginx` plugin would rewrite it).
    +
    +**D7. nginx version.** Ubuntu 24.04 ships nginx 1.24: HTTP/2 is enabled with `listen 443 ssl http2;` (the separate `http2 on;` directive exists only since 1.25.1).
    +
    +**D8. Env file.** `/etc/deanery/deanery.env`, owner `<APP_USER>`, mode 600 (systemd reads it as root; operators run `deploy/manage.sh` as the app user). Values must not need shell quoting: secrets are generated with `secrets.token_urlsafe` / `openssl rand -hex` (letters, digits, `-`, `_`); `DEMO_PASSWORD` uses only letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`. No `.env` file in the app directory.
    +
    +**D9. Env coverage test parses the sources.** Parsing `config/settings.py` (`env.<type>("NAME"…)`), `os.environ.get("NAME"…)` in management commands and `deploy/gunicorn.conf.py` finds new variables automatically; a separate fixed list would silently go stale. A guard assertion requires the parser to find the 18 variables known today.
    +
    +**D10. Trial database vs final database.** `seed_demo` creates announcements and chats only once, with dates relative to its first run. The trial deploy (now) therefore uses a throw-away database `deanery_trial` (and `/srv/deanery/private_media_trial`); on 2026-11-22 the runbook creates the final database `deanery` (and `/srv/deanery/private_media`), switches the env file, migrates, runs `seed_demo` once and restarts. No database is dropped during the jury period.
    +
    +**D11. Resources (amendment).** Swap 1 GB before any `apt`/`pip`; journald capped at 200 MB; backups gzip-compressed and kept 7 days; nginx logs rotated by the stock `/etc/logrotate.d/nginx`; PostgreSQL stock settings (do not raise `shared_buffers`; default `max_connections`).
    +

    +Placeholders in all templates: `example.com` (domain) and `<APP_USER>` (Linux user, the runbook uses `deanery`). Fixed paths: app `/srv/deanery/app`, venv `/srv/deanery/venv`, media `/srv/deanery/private_media`, backups `/srv/deanery/backups`, env file `/etc/deanery/deanery.env`, ACME webroot `/var/www/letsencrypt`.
    +Note: `docs/` is excluded from ruff (TASK-006); `deploy/gunicorn.conf.py` is NOT excluded and must pass ruff.

    +### 4.2 `deploy/gunicorn.conf.py`
    +```python
    +"""gunicorn settings for the deanery prototype (loaded with -c deploy/gunicorn.conf.py).
    +
    +Workers: 2 for 1 vCPU / 1 GB RAM. Bigger server: min(2 * vCPU + 1, (free RAM MB - 300) // 90),
    +set GUNICORN_WORKERS in /etc/deanery/deanery.env.
    +"""
    +
    +import os
    +
    +bind = os.environ.get("GUNICORN_BIND", "127.0.0.1:8000")
    +workers = max(1, int(os.environ.get("GUNICORN_WORKERS", "2")))
    +timeout = 30
    +graceful_timeout = 30
    +keepalive = 5
    +max_requests = 1000
    +max_requests_jitter = 100
    +accesslog = "-"
    +errorlog = "-"
    +loglevel = "info"
    +capture_output = True
    +control_socket_disable = True
    +```
    +
    +### 4.3 `deploy/nginx/deanery-bootstrap.conf`
    +```nginx
    +# Temporary HTTP-only site used once to obtain the first certificate (docs/DEPLOY.md step 13).
    +server {
    +    listen 80;
    +    listen [::]:80;
    +    server_name example.com;
    +    server_tokens off;
    +
    +    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
    +        root /var/www/letsencrypt;
    +        default_type "text/plain";
    +    }
    +
    +    location / {
    +        return 503;
    +    }
    +}
    +```
    +
    +### 4.4 `deploy/nginx/deanery.conf`
    +```nginx
    +# Deanery prototype. Static files are served by Django/WhiteNoise; nginx serves no project files.
    +# PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT must never get a location here (attachments go through Django access checks).
    +server {
    +    listen 80;
    +    listen [::]:80;
    +    server_name example.com;
    +    server_tokens off;
    +
    +    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
    +        root /var/www/letsencrypt;
    +        default_type "text/plain";
    +    }
    +
    +    location / {
    +        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    +    }
    +}
    +
    +server {
    +    listen 443 ssl http2;
    +    listen [::]:443 ssl http2;
    +    server_name example.com;
    +    server_tokens off;
    +
    +    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/fullchain.pem;
    +    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/privkey.pem;
    +    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    +    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
    +    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    +    ssl_session_timeout 1d;
    +    ssl_session_tickets off;
    +
    +    client_max_body_size 20m;
    +
    +    # Not set by Django; X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and HSTS come from Django.
    +    add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" always;
    +
    +    location / {
    +        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000;
    +        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    +        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    +        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    +        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    +        proxy_redirect off;
    +        proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
    +        proxy_read_timeout 60s;
    +    }
    +}
    +```
    +
    +### 4.5 `deploy/systemd/deanery.service`
    +```ini
    +[Unit]
    +Description=Deanery prototype (gunicorn)
    +After=network.target postgresql.service
    +Wants=postgresql.service
    +
    +[Service]
    +Type=simple
    +User=<APP_USER>
    +Group=<APP_USER>
    +WorkingDirectory=/srv/deanery/app
    +EnvironmentFile=/etc/deanery/deanery.env
    +ExecStart=/srv/deanery/venv/bin/gunicorn -c deploy/gunicorn.conf.py config.wsgi:application
    +Restart=on-failure
    +RestartSec=5
    +KillMode=mixed
    +TimeoutStopSec=35
    +NoNewPrivileges=true
    +PrivateTmp=true
    +ProtectSystem=full
    +ProtectHome=true
    +ReadWritePaths=/srv/deanery/private_media /srv/deanery/private_media_trial
    +
    +[Install]
    +WantedBy=multi-user.target
    +```
    +(`ReadWritePaths` entries must exist before start; the runbook creates both directories. After the switch on 2026-11-22 the trial path stays harmlessly listed.)

    +### 4.6 Small files
    +- `deploy/journald/50-deanery.conf`:
    +```ini
    +[Journal]
    +SystemMaxUse=200M
    +SystemKeepFree=1G
    +MaxRetentionSec=14day
    +```
    +- `deploy/ssh/10-deanery-hardening.conf` (the name sorts before Ubuntu's `50-cloud-init.conf`; sshd uses the first value it reads):
    +```text
    +PasswordAuthentication no
    +KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
    +PermitRootLogin prohibit-password
    +PubkeyAuthentication yes
    +```
    +- `deploy/cron/deanery-backup` (installed to `/etc/cron.d/deanery-backup`; server time zone is Europe/Moscow, step 2):
    +```text
    +# Daily backup of PostgreSQL and PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT at 04:30 Moscow time.
    +30 4 * * * <APP_USER> /srv/deanery/app/deploy/backup.sh 2>&1 | logger -t deanery-backup
    +```
    +- `deploy/manage.sh`:
    +```bash
    +#!/usr/bin/env bash
    +# Run a Django management command with the production environment.
    +# Usage: sudo -u <APP_USER> /srv/deanery/app/deploy/manage.sh <command> [args]
    +set -euo pipefail
    +set -a
    +. /etc/deanery/deanery.env
    +set +a
    +cd /srv/deanery/app
    +exec /srv/deanery/venv/bin/python manage.py "$@"
    +```
    +- `deploy/backup.sh`:
    +```bash
    +#!/usr/bin/env bash
    +# Daily backup: gzip-compressed pg_dump + tar.gz of PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT; keeps KEEP_DAYS days.
    +set -euo pipefail
    +umask 077
    +BACKUP_DIR="${BACKUP_DIR:-/srv/deanery/backups}"
    +KEEP_DAYS="${KEEP_DAYS:-7}"
    +set -a
    +. /etc/deanery/deanery.env
    +set +a
    +STAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
    +mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
    +pg_dump --no-owner --no-privileges "$DATABASE_URL" | gzip -9 > "$BACKUP_DIR/db-$STAMP.sql.gz"
    +tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR/media-$STAMP.tar.gz" -C "$(dirname "$PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT")" "$(basename "$PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT")"
    +find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'db-*.sql.gz' -o -name 'media-*.tar.gz' \) -mtime +"$((KEEP_DAYS - 1))" -delete
    +echo "backup ok: $STAMP"
    +```
    +
    +### 4.7 `.env.production.example`
    +One block per variable: a `#` comment line(s), then `NAME=value`. Values (placeholders only):
    +```text
    +# Production. Copy to /etc/deanery/deanery.env (owner <APP_USER>, mode 600). Never commit real values.
    +# Values must not need shell quoting: letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', ':', '/', ',', '@' only.
    +
    +# Must be false in production.
    +DEBUG=false
    +# Generate on the server: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(50))"
    +SECRET_KEY=replace-me-with-secrets-token-urlsafe-50-generated-on-the-server
    +# The domain without scheme; comma-separated if several.
    +ALLOWED_HOSTS=example.com
    +# Full origin with https://
    +CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://example.com
    +# Non-obvious admin path, letters/digits/-/_ only, must end with "/".
    +ADMIN_URL=staff-panel-change-me/
    +# PostgreSQL. The runbook generates the password: openssl rand -hex 24
    +DATABASE_URL=postgres://deanery:REPLACE_ME_DB_PASSWORD@localhost:5432/deanery
    +# Outside the web root and outside the repository; nginx never serves it.
    +PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT=/srv/deanery/private_media
    +# nginx sets "proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;" (deploy/nginx/deanery.conf).
    +CLIENT_IP_HEADER=X-Real-IP
    +# HTTPS redirect in Django (nginx redirects too).
    +SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT=true
    +# Start small; raise to 31536000 after the site works over HTTPS (docs/DEPLOY.md, HSTS).
    +SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=3600
    +# true is required by "check --deploy"; every subdomain of the domain must use HTTPS.
    +SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS=true
    +# Never true for this prototype (irreversible browser preload list).
    +SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD=false
    +LOG_LEVEL=INFO
    +# Password of all demo accounts (seed_demo); letters, digits, '-', '_', '.' only; passes Django validators.
    +DEMO_PASSWORD=REPLACE_ME_DEMO_PASSWORD
    +# Login lockout per (username, IP).
    +LOGIN_FAILURE_LIMIT=5
    +LOGIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS=900
    +# gunicorn (deploy/gunicorn.conf.py): 2 workers for 1 vCPU / 1 GB RAM.
    +GUNICORN_WORKERS=2
    +GUNICORN_BIND=127.0.0.1:8000
    +```

    +
    +### 4.9 `docs/DEPLOY.md` — required content and order
    +English, numbered steps; every step shows the exact commands in a `bash` block, run as the sudo user unless stated. Use shell variables set once in step 0: `DOMAIN=example.com`, `APP_USER=deanery`, `REPO_URL=<your repository URL>`. Sections:
    +0. **Before you start** — what you need (domain A record → server IP, SSH key created by the user: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519`, `ssh-copy-id`), the variables above, and a warning: keep one SSH session open until step 4 is verified.
    +1. **Swap first (1 GB RAM)** — `sudo fallocate -l 1G /swapfile && sudo chmod 600 /swapfile && sudo mkswap /swapfile && sudo swapon /swapfile`; `echo '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab`; `echo 'vm.swappiness=10' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-deanery-swap.conf && sudo sysctl --system`; check `free -h`. Must come before any `apt`/`pip` step.
    +2. **Time zone** — `sudo timedatectl set-timezone Europe/Moscow` (cron and logs in Moscow time).
    +3. **Packages** — `sudo apt update && sudo apt -y upgrade`; `sudo apt -y install python3.12-venv nginx postgresql certbot git ufw`.
    +4. **SSH: keys only** — copy `deploy/ssh/10-deanery-hardening.conf` (from the repo after step 7, or paste its 4 lines) to `/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/`; `sudo sshd -t && sudo systemctl reload ssh`; verify `sudo sshd -T | grep -Ei 'passwordauthentication|permitrootlogin'`; open a NEW session with the key before closing the old one. (May be done right after step 7.)
    +5. **Firewall** — `sudo ufw allow OpenSSH && sudo ufw allow 80/tcp && sudo ufw allow 443/tcp && sudo ufw --force enable && sudo ufw status` (only 22, 80, 443).
    +6. **journald limit** — install `deploy/journald/50-deanery.conf` to `/etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/` (`sudo mkdir -p …`), `sudo systemctl restart systemd-journald`, check `journalctl --disk-usage`. nginx logs: rotated by the stock `/etc/logrotate.d/nginx` (no action).
    +7. **App user, directories, code** — `sudo adduser --system --group --home /srv/deanery --shell /bin/bash "$APP_USER"`; `sudo -u "$APP_USER" git clone "$REPO_URL" /srv/deanery/app`; `sudo -u "$APP_USER" mkdir -p /srv/deanery/private_media /srv/deanery/private_media_trial /srv/deanery/backups`; `sudo chmod 750 /srv/deanery/private_media /srv/deanery/private_media_trial && sudo chmod 700 /srv/deanery/backups`; `sudo mkdir -p /var/www/letsencrypt`.
    +8. **Python venv** — `sudo -u "$APP_USER" python3.12 -m venv /srv/deanery/venv`; `sudo -u "$APP_USER" /srv/deanery/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip`; `sudo -u "$APP_USER" /srv/deanery/venv/bin/pip install -r /srv/deanery/app/requirements.txt` (production requirements only).
    +9. **PostgreSQL (trial database)** — stock settings: do NOT raise `shared_buffers`, keep `max_connections`. `DB_PASS=$(openssl rand -hex 24)`; `sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE ROLE deanery LOGIN PASSWORD '$DB_PASS';" -c "CREATE DATABASE deanery_trial OWNER deanery ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0;"`.
    +10. **Environment file** — `sudo mkdir -p /etc/deanery`; build it from `.env.production.example` with `sed` replacing: `example.com` → `$DOMAIN`; `SECRET_KEY` → `$(python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(50))")`; `REPLACE_ME_DB_PASSWORD` → `$DB_PASS`; database name `/deanery` → `/deanery_trial` and `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT` → `/srv/deanery/private_media_trial` (trial, D10); `ADMIN_URL` → `staff-$(openssl rand -hex 6)/`; `DEMO_PASSWORD` → a password the user chooses (allowed characters, D8); write to `/etc/deanery/deanery.env`; `sudo chown "$APP_USER:$APP_USER" /etc/deanery/deanery.env && sudo chmod 600 /etc/deanery/deanery.env`; `unset DB_PASS`. Show the final file with `sudo -u "$APP_USER" grep -v -E 'SECRET_KEY|PASSWORD' /etc/deanery/deanery.env` (never print secrets).
    +11. **Django** — `M="sudo -u $APP_USER /srv/deanery/app/deploy/manage.sh"`; `$M migrate`; `$M collectstatic --noinput`; `$M check --deploy --fail-level WARNING`; `$M createsuperuser` (role must stay empty — Django superuser for the admin only).
    +12. **gunicorn + systemd** — copy `deploy/systemd/deanery.service` with `sed "s/<APP_USER>/$APP_USER/g"` to `/etc/systemd/system/deanery.service`; `sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now deanery`; check `systemctl status deanery`, `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/` → `{"status": "ok"}` (Host header: `curl -s -H "Host: $DOMAIN" …`), `journalctl -u deanery -n 50`.
    +13. **nginx bootstrap + certificate** — install `deploy/nginx/deanery-bootstrap.conf` (with `sed "s/example.com/$DOMAIN/g"`) to `/etc/nginx/sites-available/deanery`, link to `sites-enabled`, remove `sites-enabled/default`, `sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx`; `sudo certbot certonly --webroot -w /var/www/letsencrypt -d "$DOMAIN" --email <your e-mail> --agree-tos --no-eff-email --deploy-hook "systemctl reload nginx"`.
    +14. **nginx full site** — replace with `deploy/nginx/deanery.conf` (same `sed`), `sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx`; auto-renewal: `systemctl list-timers certbot.timer` and `sudo certbot renew --dry-run`.
    +15. **Backups** — install `deploy/cron/deanery-backup` with `sed "s/<APP_USER>/$APP_USER/g"` to `/etc/cron.d/deanery-backup` (mode 644, root-owned); run once by hand `sudo -u "$APP_USER" /srv/deanery/app/deploy/backup.sh` and list `/srv/deanery/backups`; files older than 7 days are deleted by the script. Restore (short): `gunzip -c db-….sql.gz | psql "$DATABASE_URL"` into an empty database + `tar -xzf media-….tar.gz -C /srv/deanery` — always restore BOTH (README «Deployment notes»).
    +16. **Smoke check** — `curl -sI http://$DOMAIN/` → 301 to https; `curl -s https://$DOMAIN/health/` → ok; browser: login page, admin at `https://$DOMAIN/<ADMIN_URL>`; on the trial database run `$M seed_demo` (trial only) and open one page per role (student: Расписание, Заявки, Чат; staff: Заявки, Чаты); upload a PDF to a request (checks `client_max_body_size`); download it; `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$DOMAIN/private_media/` → 404 (no static route to private files).
    +17. **Final database on 2026-11-22 (once)** — create `deanery` DB owned by `deanery` (same role); edit the env file: database name `deanery_trial` → `deanery`, `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT=/srv/deanery/private_media`; `$M migrate`; `$M seed_demo` (ONCE, no cron, needs `DEMO_PASSWORD`); `sudo systemctl restart deanery`; repeat step 16 (without seeding). Optionally drop `deanery_trial` and empty `private_media_trial` after 2026-11-28.
    +18. **Update procedure** — `sudo -u "$APP_USER" git -C /srv/deanery/app pull --ff-only`; `sudo -u "$APP_USER" /srv/deanery/venv/bin/pip install -r /srv/deanery/app/requirements.txt`; `$M migrate`; `$M collectstatic --noinput`; `$M check --deploy --fail-level WARNING`; `sudo systemctl restart deanery`; smoke check.
    +19. **HSTS** — after the site works over HTTPS for a day: set `SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=31536000` in the env file, restart; never enable `SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD`. Explain that a large value cannot be undone for visitors before it expires, so raise it only after HTTPS is confirmed.
    +20. **Resources** — expected memory: gunicorn master + 2 workers ≈ 200–250 MB, PostgreSQL ≈ 100–150 MB, nginx ≈ 10 MB, system ≈ 200 MB → ≈ 600 MB of 1 GB, swap covers peaks (pip install, migrations); disk: venv ≈ 150 MB, journal ≤ 200 MB, backups (7 days, gzip) small. Спецификация TASK-011 готова и передана Кодеру: [docs/tasks/TASK-011.md](docs/tasks/TASK-011.md). Поправку про сервер (1 vCPU, 1 ГБ, 10 ГБ) я учёл.

**Главные решения:**
- **gunicorn 26.2.0.** Ветке 27.x всего неделя, ставить её перед деплоем рискованно. Я запустил 26.2.0 с нашим конфигом на копии проекта: 2 процесса стартовали, `/health/` ответил 200. В версии 26 есть «управляющий сокет» в домашней папке, в конфиге он выключен.
- **2 процесса gunicorn по умолчанию.** Число задаётся переменной `GUNICORN_WORKERS`. Формула для сервера побольше записана в конфиге и в инструкции.
- **gunicorn слушает только 127.0.0.1:8000.** Это проще unix-сокета, потому что не нужно настраивать права между nginx и пользователем приложения. Снаружи порт закрыт.
- **Статику отдаёт WhiteNoise, а не nginx.** Так у nginx нет ни одной папки с файлами проекта, и он физически не может отдать `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT`.
- **Сертификат через certbot по webroot.** Сначала ставится временный конфиг только с HTTP, потом основной. Автопродление делает стандартный таймер certbot. Сам конфиг nginx лежит в репозитории и проверяется тестами.
- **IP клиента берётся из заголовка `X-Real-IP`.** nginx его перезаписывает, поэтому подменить его снаружи нельзя.
- **Ресурсы.** Сначала создаётся swap 1 ГБ, потом ставятся пакеты. Журнал systemd ограничен 200 МБ. Резервные копии сжимаются и хранятся 7 дней. Настройки PostgreSQL остаются стандартными. В инструкции есть раздел «Resources» с расходом памяти и командами проверки.

**Что важно решить тебе и тимлиду:**
- **Пробная и итоговая база.** `seed_demo` создаёт объявления и чаты только при первом запуске, и их даты отсчитываются от дня запуска. Если запустить его сейчас, сроки объявлений придутся на 18–22.11, а не на неделю жюри. Поэтому в инструкции так:
  - пробный деплой идёт на отдельной базе `deanery_trial`;
  - 22.11 создаётся итоговая база `deanery`, и на ней один раз запускается `seed_demo`;
  - удалять данные во время проверки жюри не нужно.
- **PostgreSQL проверит только CI.** Локально у меня нет ни PostgreSQL, ни nginx, а Docker не запущен. Поэтому полный прогон тестов на PostgreSQL сделает новая задача в CI после того, как тимлид отправит коммит. Если там что-то упадёт, понадобится быстрый круг исправлений. Если запустить Docker Desktop, Кодер сможет проверить PostgreSQL заранее.
- **`nginx -t` здесь не запустить.** Его нужно выполнить на сервере, в инструкции это шаги 13–14.

**Проверка на текущем коде:**
- Тесты прошли: 964 в трёх прогонах, в том числе в 23:59:59 и 00:00 по Москве. Сбоев не было.
- `check --deploy` проходит с боевыми значениями-заглушками.
- ruff, `node --check`, проверка YAML и двойной запуск `seed_demo` прошли.

Для проверки я запускал тестовый gunicorn на порту 8765. Песочница не давала его остановить, поэтому одну команду `kill` я выполнил вне песочницы. Процесс остановлен.

## Goal
The whole site gets the approved "night pixel" look, readable and usable on a 360 px phone and on a desktop, without JavaScript.

## Requirements (user decisions)
1. Theme (from the mockup):
   - Background: vertical night-sky gradient (#120a2a -> #221449 -> #3a2272 -> #4b2a86), full page height.
   - Decorative pixel stars (small yellow #ffe9a8 and lilac #d9c8ff squares) only in the header area and the side margins; never over text or controls; pure CSS, `aria-hidden`, no images.
   - Panels/cards: dark violet (about rgba(36,22,78,.88)), pixel double frame (3px border #5a3fa3 + 3px gap + 3px outer line, square corners, no border-radius).
   - Text #f3ecff, muted #b8a6e8, card headings yellow #ffd25e, links amber #ffc46b (underlined), warnings/changes coral #ff6f7d, the "идёт" tag and the unread count orange/coral as in the mockup. Headings have a 3px violet pixel text-shadow.
   - Put all colours into `tokens.css` as named tokens; the theme rules into `theme.css`; layout stays in `base.css`.
2. Fonts (user decision): Press Start 2P ONLY for the site title, headings, card titles, buttons and tags; all body text, form inputs, tables and messages use the existing system font for readability. Define sizes so long Russian words do not overflow at 360 px (check the longest headings and button labels).
3. Logo (user decision): the pixel academic cap from the mockup (inline SVG of rects, `shape-rendering: crispEdges`, our own drawing) next to the site title "ЦИФРОВОЙ ДЕКАНАТ" (two lines on narrow screens). Also use it as the favicon (SVG favicon).
4. Header (user decisions):
   - Narrow screens: logo + title; below them two buttons on one line: "≡ Меню" (the existing no-JS `<details>` menu from TASK-008-FIX) and, for students, a "Уведомления" BUTTON (not a text link) with a yellow pixel bell icon and a coral count chip; the chip is hidden when there are no unread items. Both buttons have the same height and the pixel button style.
   - Wide screens (>= 48rem): the inline nav as now, styled; the notifications button stays visible.
   - Staff and superuser: the same header without the notifications button.
5. Student home page (`core:home`), as in the mockup: heading "Сегодня" with the date and group; a card "Занятия" with today's lessons (reuse the schedule service of the "Сегодня" page: time, pair, discipline, type, teacher, room link to the map, change marks, "идёт" tag for the current lesson; empty state "Сегодня занятий нет"); a card "Дедлайны" (existing home summary, 3 items); a card "Новости" (existing, 3 items). The card titles "Дедлайны" and "Новости" are links (user decision): "Дедлайны" -> the notifications page scrolled to its "Ближайшие дедлайны" block (add a stable anchor id there, e.g. `#deadlines`), "Новости" -> the notifications page scrolled to the feed (e.g. `#feed`); the link look must make it clear they are clickable (e.g. an arrow "→" after the title) while keeping the card-title style; keep or drop the existing "Все уведомления" link - choose and justify. The "Новости" card has exactly the same look as the "Дедлайны" card (same card, title style, row layout and separators; for news the right-hand part is the date instead of the relative deadline label). In both cards every row is ONE line at any screen width: the title is truncated with an ellipsis ("Текст текст текст…", CSS `white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis` on the title part, `min-width: 0` in the flex row) while the right-hand label (deadline label or date) is never truncated or wrapped; the full title stays available (link text unchanged for screen readers, and a `title` attribute with the full text). Test the markup/classes; the Team lead checks 320, 360 and 1024 px visually; then two buttons of the SAME style and size side by side on one line: "Документы" (-> the student's requests list) and "Чат" (-> the student chat). Query count of the home page must stay small and fixed (test).
6. Staff home page: heading and three buttons of the same style: "Заявки", "Чаты", "Объявления".
7. Every other page gets the theme without changing its behaviour: login, profile, schedule (today/week/staff), grades report (including `<details>`), requests (catalog, form with file input, list, detail, staff queue/detail), notifications feed and staff announcements, chat (student/staff; own vs other messages clearly different), map page (the map must stay readable on the dark background: room and landmark colours adapted to the theme; the current highlight colour must remain clearly visible - the map redesign itself is the NEXT task), Django messages block, empty states, error pages 403/404/500 (add simple themed templates if missing), the footer disclaimer.
8. Forms: inputs, selects, textareas and the file input themed and readable (light text on dark field or dark on light - choose for contrast), visible focus outline (pixel style), error messages in coral, buttons as in the mockup. Tap targets at least 44 px.
9. Accessibility: WCAG AA contrast for text (4.5:1, 3:1 for large text and UI borders) - list the checked pairs in the spec; `:focus-visible` on every interactive element; no information by colour only; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected if any transition is added; zoom works.
10. No JavaScript added; chat polling JS unchanged. No new Python dependencies. Admin site unchanged.

    {% extends "base.html" %}
    {% block title %}Карта{% endblock %}
    {% block content %}
    <h1>Карта</h1>
    {% if not floors %}
      <p>Аудиторий пока нет.</p>
    {% else %}
      <nav class="floor-switcher" aria-label="Этажи">
        <span>Этаж:</span>
        <ul>
          {% for f in floors %}
          <li><a href="{{ f.url }}"{% if f.is_current %} class="floor-current" aria-current="page"{% endif %}>{{ f.number }}</a></li>
          {% endfor %}
        </ul>
      </nav>
      {% if plan %}
      <svg class="map-svg" viewBox="0 0 {{ plan.width }} {{ plan.height }}" role="img" aria-labelledby="map-title">
        <title id="map-title">Схема, {{ plan.floor }} этаж</title>
        <rect class="map-outline" x="{{ plan.outline.x }}" y="{{ plan.outline.y }}" width="{{ plan.outline.width }}" height="{{ plan.outline.height }}"/>
        <rect class="map-corridor" x="{{ plan.corridor.x }}" y="{{ plan.corridor.y }}" width="{{ plan.corridor.width }}" height="{{ plan.corridor.height }}"/>
        {% for s in plan.shapes %}
        <g class="map-{{ s.kind }}{% if s.is_current %} map-current{% endif %}"{% if s.is_current %} aria-current="location"{% endif %}>
          <title>{% if s.kind == "room" %}Аудитория {{ s.label }}{% else %}{{ s.label }}{% endif %}</title>
          {% if s.points %}<polygon points="{{ s.points }}"/>{% else %}<rect x="{{ s.rect.x }}" y="{{ s.rect.y }}" width="{{ s.rect.width }}" height="{{ s.rect.height }}"/>{% endif %}
          <text class="map-{{ s.kind }}-label" x="{{ s.rect.cx }}" y="{{ s.rect.cy }}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central"{% if s.text_length %} textLength="{{ s.text_length }}" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"{% endif %}>{{ s.label }}</text>
        </g>
        {% endfor %}
      </svg>
      {% else %}<p>Схемы {{ current_floor }} этажа нет.</p>{% endif %}
      <ul class="map-legend">
        <li><svg class="map-legend-swatch" viewBox="0 0 24 16" aria-hidden="true"><g class="map-room"><rect x="1" y="1" width="22" height="14"/></g></svg> Аудитория</li>
        <li><svg class="map-legend-swatch" viewBox="0 0 24 16" aria-hidden="true"><g class="map-landmark"><rect x="1" y="1" width="22" height="14"/></g></svg> Вход, лестница, деканат, библиотека, столовая</li>
        <li><svg class="map-legend-swatch" viewBox="0 0 24 16" aria-hidden="true"><g class="map-service"><rect x="1" y="1" width="22" height="14"/></g></svg> Служебные помещения: гардероб, туалеты, кафедра и другие</li>

      {% endfor %}

    {% block content %}
      <h1>Мои заявки</h1>
      <p class="page-actions"><a href="{% url 'petitions:catalog' %}">Подать заявку</a></p>

          {% for petition in petitions %}
            <li class="petition">

              · № {{ petition.short_id }}
              · {{ petition.created_at|date:"j E Y" }}
              · <span class="status status--{{ petition.status }}">{{ petition.get_status_display }}</span>
              · готовность: {{ petition.expected_ready_date|date:"j E Y" }}
            </li>
          {% endfor %}
        </ul>
      {% else %}
        <p>Заявок пока нет.</p>
      {% endif %}
    {% endblock %}

    === petitions/templates/petitions/staff_queue.html
    {% extends "base.html" %}
    {% block content %}
      <h1>Заявки</h1>
      <form method="get" class="form">
        <p>
          <label for="status">Статус</label>
          <select name="status" id="status">
            {% for value, label in status_choices %}
              <option value="{{ value }}"{% if value == selected_status %} selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
        </p>
        <p>
          <label for="type">Вид заявки</label>
          <select name="type" id="type">
            <option value="">Все</option>
            {% for t in types %}
              <option value="{{ t.pk }}"{% if t.pk|stringformat:"s" == selected_type %} selected{% endif %}>{{ t.name }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
        </p>
        <button type="submit">Показать</button>
      </form>
      {% if petitions %}
        <ul class="petition-list">
          {% for petition in petitions %}
            <li class="petition">
              <a href="{% url 'petitions:staff_detail' petition.public_id %}">{{ petition.student.full_name }}</a>
              · {{ petition.student.group.name }}
              · {{ petition.request_type.name }}
              · {{ petition.created_at|date:"j E Y" }}
              · <span class="status status--{{ petition.status }}">{{ petition.get_status_display }}</span>
              · файлов: {{ petition.attachment_count }}
            </li>
          {% endfor %}
        </ul>
      {% else %}
        <p>Заявок нет.</p>
      {% endif %}
    {% endblock %}
    === petitions/templates/petitions/staff_detail.html
    {% extends "base.html" %}
    {% block content %}
      <h1>Заявка № {{ petition.short_id }}</h1>
      <h2>Студент</h2>
      <p>{{ petition.student.full_name }}</p>
      <p>{{ petition.student.group.name }}</p>
      <p>№ зачётной книжки: {{ petition.student.record_number }}</p>
      <h2>Заявка</h2>
      <p>{{ petition.request_type.name }}</p>
      <p class="status status--{{ petition.status }}">{{ petition.get_status_display }}</p>
      <p>Подана: {{ petition.created_at|date:"j E Y H:i" }}</p>
      <p>Ожидаемая дата готовности: {{ petition.expected_ready_date|date:"j E Y" }}</p>
      {% if petition.comment %}<p>{{ petition.comment }}</p>{% endif %}
      {% include "petitions/includes/attachments.html" %}
      {% include "petitions/includes/history.html" %}
      {% include "petitions/includes/comments.html" %}
      {% if actions %}
        <h2>Действия</h2>
        {% for status, label in actions %}
          <form method="post" action="{% url 'petitions:staff_transition' petition.public_id %}" class="action-form">
            {% csrf_token %}
            <input type="hidden" name="expected_status" value="{{ petition.status }}">
            <input type="hidden" name="new_status" value="{{ status }}">
            {% if status == "rejected" %}
              <p><label for="comment-{{ status }}">Причина отклонения</label></p>
              <textarea name="comment" id="comment-{{ status }}" rows="3" required></textarea>
            {% endif %}
            <button type="submit">{{ label }}</button>
          </form>
        {% endfor %}
      {% endif %}
      <h2>Комментарий</h2>
      <form method="post" action="{% url 'petitions:staff_comment' petition.public_id %}" class="action-form">
        {% csrf_token %}
        {{ comment_form.as_p }}
        <button type="submit">Добавить комментарий</button>
      </form>
    {% endblock %}

    $ cat > "$TMPDIR/t012/cmap.py" <<'EOF'
  import struct,sys
  d=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
  n=struct.unpack('>H',d[4:6])[0]
  tables={d[12+16*i:16+16*i].decode():struct.unpack('>II',d[20+16*i:28+16*i]) for i in range(n)}
  off=tables['cmap'][0]
  nt=struct.unpack('>H',d[off+2:off+4])[0]
  cps=set()
  for i in range(nt):
      pid,eid,so=struct.unpack('>HHI',d[off+4+8*i:off+12+8*i])
      s=off+so; fmt=struct.unpack('>H',d[s:s+2])[0]
      if fmt==4:
          segx2=struct.unpack('>H',d[s+6:s+8])[0]; seg=segx2//2
          ends=struct.unpack(f'>{seg}H',d[s+14:s+14+segx2]); starts=struct.unpack(f'>{seg}H',d[s+16+segx2:s+16+2*segx2])
          for a,b in zip(starts,ends): cps.update(range(a,b+1))
  for ch in 'ЁёАЯаяЙй≡→←·…–—№«»':
      print(repr(ch), hex(ord(ch)), ord(ch) in cps)
  EOF

    +# TASK-012: "Night pixel" visual theme for the whole site
    +
    +Assignee: **UI coder** (thr_pgcwc2dwnn). Request: Team lead, approved by the user (plan.md stage 4, "Интерфейс (пиксель-арт)").
    +
    +## Goal
    +
    +The whole site gets the approved "night pixel" look. It is readable and usable on a 360 px phone and on a desktop. No JavaScript is added. Behaviour stays the same, except for the student and staff home pages and the header, which this spec redesigns.
    +
    +Design references (read both before you start):
    +- `docs/design/home-mockup.html` (open it in the browser; it is the reference for colours, frames, buttons and the header);
    +- `docs/design/home-mockup.jpg` (the approved screenshot, 360 px).
    +
    +## Acceptance criteria
    +
    +- AC1. **Tokens.** Every colour of the theme is a named custom property in `static/css/tokens.css` (list in D3). `static/css/base.css` and `static/css/theme.css` contain no colour literals (`#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`, `hsla(`). Only tokens.css contains them.
    +- AC2. **Font.** `static/fonts/PressStart2P-Regular.ttf` and `static/fonts/OFL.txt` stay byte-identical (SHA-256 below). `theme.css` declares `@font-face` with `src: url("../fonts/PressStart2P-Regular.ttf") format("truetype")` and `font-display: swap`. The font is used only for: the site title, `h1`, `h2`, card titles, buttons (D6) and tags (D7). Body text, `h3`, nav links, form fields, tables, lists and messages use `--font-body`. `collectstatic` with `CompressedManifestStaticFilesStorage` rewrites the font URL in the processed `theme.css` to the hashed file name.
    +- AC3. **No external resources.** No template and no CSS file contains `https://`, `@import` or a `url(` that does not start with `../`. Templates may contain `http://` only as the exact SVG namespace `http://www.w3.org/2000/svg` (and they do not need it at all; see D9). Only `chat/student.html` and `chat/staff_dialog.html` contain `<script`. `static/js/` contains only `chat.js`, unchanged.
    +- AC4. **Logo and favicon.** The header shows the pixel academic cap (inline SVG of `<rect>` elements, `shape-rendering="crispEdges"`, `aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"`; our own drawing, copied from the mockup) and the title "Цифровой деканат" (shown in capitals by CSS, two lines below 48rem). `static/img/favicon.svg` is the same cap. `base.html` and `500.html` link it with `<link rel="icon" href="…/img/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">`.
    +- AC5. **Header for students.** The header has the brand, the wide nav (≥ 48rem) or the "Меню" `<details>` menu (< 48rem), and a "Уведомления" button with a yellow pixel bell. The button is visible at every width. The button shows a count chip only when the badge is not empty. The badge is computed once per page (existing test `test_badge_computed_once`). The nav lists no longer contain a "Уведомления" item (D11).
    +- AC6. **Header for staff, superuser and anonymous users.** There is no notifications button. Staff and superusers have the same menu and wide nav as before. Anonymous pages have no menu (existing test `test_anonymous_unchanged`).
    +- AC7. **Student home** (`core:home`, a student with a profile). It shows the `h1` "Сегодня", the date and the group. Then three cards in this order: "Занятия" (today's lessons: time, pair number, discipline, type, teacher, room link to the map, change mark, the "идёт" tag on the current lesson; empty state "Сегодня занятий нет."), "Дедлайны" and "Новости" (at most 3 rows each). Then two buttons on one line: "Документы" (→ `/requests/`) and "Чат" (→ `/chat/`). The titles "Дедлайны" and "Новости" are links to `/notifications/#deadlines` and `/notifications/#feed`, with an arrow "→" after the text. The old "Все уведомления" link is removed (D12).
    +- AC8. **Card rows.** In "Дедлайны" and "Новости", each row is one line at every width. The title is a link, cut with an ellipsis and carrying a `title` attribute with the full title. The right-hand label (relative deadline label, or the news date `dd.mm`) is never cut or wrapped.
    +- AC9. **Staff home.** `h1` "Деканат" and three buttons of the same style and size: "Заявки" (→ `/staff/requests/`), "Чаты" (→ `/staff/chats/`), "Объявления" (→ `/staff/announcements/`).
    +- AC10. **Other roles on home.** A student without a profile and a superuser see the old placeholder ("Раздел в разработке").
    +- AC11. **Anchors on the feed page.** `/notifications/` has `<section id="deadlines" …>` and `<section id="feed" …>`.
    +- AC12. **Home query count.** For a student with two lessons today (one with a room change), one deadline, one news item and one unread chat message, `GET /` makes exactly **14** queries. The count is the same with 1 and 3 lessons, and the same with 0 and 4 deadlines.
    +- AC13. **Error pages.** `templates/403.html` and `templates/404.html` extend `base.html` and show a themed heading, a short text and a "На главную" button. `templates/500.html` is a standalone page (it does not extend `base.html`, uses no context variables and makes no queries) with the same look.
    +- AC14. **All pages themed** (list in "Pages" below) without behaviour changes. Forms, inputs, selects, textareas, the file input, errors, messages, empty states, `<details>`, tables and the footer are themed. Tap targets are at least 44 px (D14). Every interactive element has a visible `:focus-visible` style.
    +- AC15. **Map readable.** Rooms, landmarks, service rooms and the corridor are visible on the dark background. The current room is clearly marked by stroke width, fill and label colour, not by hue alone. The map redesign itself is TASK-013.
    +- AC16. **Contrast.** Every text/background pair in the "Contrast" table meets WCAG AA. Coral text uses `--color-warn-text` (D4).
    +- AC17. **No horizontal scroll** at 320, 360 and 1024 px on every page in the "Pages" list, for a student and for staff.
    +- AC18. **README** has a "## Design" section: palette, font name, licence (SIL OFL 1.1, Reserved Font Name "Press Start 2P", file `static/fonts/OFL.txt`, used unmodified), and "the logo and favicon are our own pixel drawing".
    +- AC19. The admin site is unchanged (no `templates/admin/`). No new Python dependencies. No migrations.
    +
    +## Out of scope
    +
    +- Map improvements: a larger room list, the final highlight design, landmark vs service frames, the corridor label, zoom (TASK-013).
    +- New features, new pages, behaviour changes other than those listed in AC5–AC13.
    +- A light theme or a theme switcher. Any JavaScript. Transitions and animations (D15).
    +- Changes to `static/js/chat.js`, models, migrations, forms, URLs and permissions.
    +
    +## Design decisions
    +
    +- **D1. CSS layers.** `tokens.css` holds only custom properties (colours, fonts, font sizes, frame sizes). `base.css` holds layout (display, flex/grid, spacing, widths, the ellipsis rules, visibility by breakpoint, `.visually-hidden`). `theme.css` holds the look: `@font-face`, backgrounds, the gradient, stars, frames, shadows, colours via `var(--…)`, fonts, focus styles, form looks, map colours. All three files stay linked in this order (existing test `test_home_css_layers_in_order`). Keep the existing rules that tests check: `input, select, textarea, button { max-width: 100%; … }` in base.css; `.site-nav--wide { display: none; }` and the `@media (min-width: 48rem) { .site-nav--wide { display: block; } .site-nav-compact { display: none; …` block in base.css; `.chat-message--own { margin-left:` and `.chat-message--other { margin-right:` in base.css; `.map-current .map-room-label` with `var(--color-map-highlight)` in base.css. theme.css must not contain `max-width: 100%`.
    +- **D2. Breakpoint.** One breakpoint, `48rem`, as now. You may add `min-width: 64rem` rules for desktop font sizes if needed.
    +- **D3. Tokens.** Keep the existing names (base.css uses them) with new values, and add new ones. Required names and values:
    +
    +  | Token | Value | Use |
    +  |---|---|---|
    +  | `--color-bg` | `#120a2a` | fallback page background |
    +  | `--color-sky-1` … `--color-sky-4` | `#120a2a`, `#221449`, `#3a2272`, `#4b2a86` | page gradient stops (0%, 40%, 75%, 100%) |
    +  | `--color-panel` | `rgba(36, 22, 78, 0.88)` | cards, panels, buttons |
    +  | `--color-frame` | `#5a3fa3` | pixel frame lines, heading text-shadow |
    +  | `--color-frame-gap` | `#170d33` | the 3 px gap between frame lines |
    +  | `--color-text` | `#f3ecff` | text |
    +  | `--color-muted` | `#b8a6e8` | secondary text |
    +  | `--color-heading` | `#ffd25e` | card titles, bell icon |
    +  | `--color-link` | `#ffc46b` | links |
    +  | `--color-accent` | `#ffc46b` | existing name; same value as link |
    +  | `--color-border` | `#5a3fa3` | existing name; dashed separators |
    +  | `--color-warn` | `#ff6f7d` | coral backgrounds (count chip) |
    +  | `--color-warn-text` | `#ff8a95` | coral text: changes, errors, deadline labels (D4) |
    +  | `--color-changed` | `#ff8a95` | existing name; same value as warn-text |
    +  | `--color-orange` | `#ff9f2e` | tags, primary buttons, logo |
    +  | `--color-orange-light` | `#ffc04d` | primary button gradient top |
    +  | `--color-orange-dark` | `#f07a1a` | primary button gradient bottom |
    +  | `--color-orange-edge` | `#ffd98a` | primary button border |
    +  | `--color-on-accent` | `#2b1300` | text on orange, on coral |
    +  | `--color-now-bg` | `rgba(255, 159, 46, 0.14)` | existing name; current lesson tint |
    +  | `--color-field-bg` | `#170d33` | inputs, selects, textareas |
    +  | `--color-field-border` | `#a58cf0` | input borders (3:1, D4) |
    +  | `--color-focus` | `#ffd25e` | focus outline |
    +  | `--color-star-yellow`, `--color-star-lilac` | `#ffe9a8`, `#d9c8ff` | stars |
    +  | `--color-map-highlight` | `#ffd25e` | existing name; current room |
    +  | `--color-map-highlight-fill` | `rgba(255, 210, 94, 0.22)` | current room fill |
    +  | `--color-map-room-fill` | `rgba(36, 22, 78, 0.88)` | room fill |
    +  | `--font-body` | unchanged system stack | body text |
    +  | `--font-pixel` | `"Press Start 2P", ui-monospace, monospace` | pixel font |
    +  | `--font-heading` | `var(--font-pixel)` | existing name |
    +  | `--font-size-title`, `--font-size-h1`, `--font-size-h2`, `--font-size-button`, `--font-size-tag` | in `rem` (D5) | pixel text sizes |
    +  | `--frame-width` | `3px` | frame line and gap |
    +
    +  You may add more tokens (for example a slightly lighter corridor fill). Every colour stays in tokens.css.
    +- **D4. Contrast rules** (computed with the WCAG 2.x formula; the panel is composited over the lightest sky colour `#4b2a86`, which gives `#29184f`, the worst case):
    +  - On the bare sky (the page outside cards), only `--color-text`, `--color-muted`, `--color-heading`, `--color-link`, `--color-warn-text` and `--color-orange` may be used as text colours.
    +  - `#ff6f7d` (mockup coral) gives only 3.96:1 on `#4b2a86`. Coral **text** therefore always uses `--color-warn-text` `#ff8a95` (4.72:1 on the lightest sky, 6.87:1 on the panel).
    +  - The count chip is `--color-warn` background with `--color-on-accent` text (6.54:1). The mockup's white text on coral gives 2.68:1, which fails. This is a deliberate change from the mockup.
    +  - Input borders use `--color-field-border` `#a58cf0` (3.85:1 on the lightest sky, 5.61:1 on the panel, 6.66:1 against the field). The `#5a3fa3` frame (1.35–2.43:1) is used only for decorative frames of cards and buttons. Buttons are identified by their visible text label (WCAG 1.4.11 does not require a contrasting border then).
    +  - The focus outline is `--color-focus` (≥ 7.41:1 on every background).
    +- **D5. Pixel text sizes.** Press Start 2P is monospace: every glyph is exactly 1em wide (`unitsPerEm` 1000, all advance widths 1000; checked from the font's `hmtx` table). A word of N letters at size S is N×S px wide. Content width is 288 px at 320 px and 328 px at 360 px (16 px page padding). Inside a card, subtract 2×(padding + 2 frame widths). Constraints:
    +  - `h1` < 48rem: at most `1.125rem` (18 px). The longest demo word that can appear in an `h1` is "стипендиального" (15 letters, the request type "Справка для стипендиального отдела"): 15×18 = 270 ≤ 288. You may use a larger `h1` (for example `1.5rem`) at ≥ 48rem.
    +  - `h2` and card titles: about `0.75rem` (mockup 12 px). Site title, buttons: about `0.6875rem` (mockup 11 px). Tags and chip: about `0.625rem`.
    +  - Line height for pixel text: about 1.5. Long titles and button labels may wrap between words. `body { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` stays, so no word causes horizontal scroll.
    +  - The font has no glyph for "≡" (U+2261). It has "→", "←", "·", "…", "–", "—", "№", "«", "»", "ё", "Ё" (checked from its `cmap`).
    +- **D6. Buttons.** One pixel button look:
    +  - Panel button (default): `.btn`, the menu `summary.site-menu-toggle`, the notifications button. It has `--color-panel` background, `--color-text` text, the pixel font, a double frame (3 px `--color-frame` border, then the gap and the outer line made with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-frame-gap), 0 0 0 6px var(--color-frame)`), square corners and a minimum height of 44 px.
    +  - Primary button: every `<button>` in a form (`.form button`, `.action-form button`, `.chat-form button`) and `.btn--primary`. It has the orange gradient (`--color-orange-light` → `--color-orange` → `--color-orange-dark`), `--color-orange-edge` border and `--color-on-accent` text.
    +  - The logout button in the nav looks like a nav link (system font, link colour, underlined), not like a big button. Its tap target is still at least 44 px.
    +  - The box-shadow frame takes no layout space. Leave at least 6 px around every button (gap or margin) so frames do not overlap.
    +- **D7. Tags.** `.tag` (new) and the existing `.lesson-badge` ("Сейчас", "Следующая" on the schedule) use the pixel font, `--font-size-tag`, `--color-orange` background and `--color-on-accent` text. The text stays (information is not only colour).
    +- **D8. Headings.** `h1`: pixel font, `--color-text`, `text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--color-frame)`. `h2` outside cards: pixel font, `--color-heading`. Card titles (`.card-title`, an `h2`): pixel font, `--color-heading`. `h3` stays in the body font, bold, because `h3` holds data (announcement titles, floor names, grade subsections). This is a deliberate reading of "headings" for readability.
    +- **D9. Inline SVG.** The logo and the bell are includes (`templates/includes/icon_cap.html`, `templates/includes/icon_bell.html`). Each is one `<svg>` with `viewBox`, `width`/`height`, `shape-rendering="crispEdges"`, `aria-hidden="true"`, `focusable="false"` and `<g fill="currentColor">` with the mockup's rects. Inline SVG in HTML needs no `xmlns`; do not add one. `static/img/favicon.svg` is a file, so it needs `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"` and a fixed fill `#ff9f2e` (an image file, not CSS, so AC1 does not apply). Use a square `viewBox` (for example `0 -1 12 12`).
    +- **D10. Header layout** (exact markup in F5). Order: brand, wide nav, then the actions row (`.site-nav-compact` with the `<details>` menu, then the notifications button). Below 48rem: the brand on the first line, the menu button and the notifications button on the second line, both the same height. At 320 px the two buttons may wrap to two lines; no horizontal scroll. At ≥ 48rem: the brand, the wide nav (links in the body font, wrapping as needed) and the notifications button. The open menu is a themed panel. Opening it must not move the notifications button out of view. The menu items are at least 44 px high. The "≡" icon is drawn in CSS on `summary.site-menu-toggle::before` (three 2–3 px bars made with `box-shadow` or a gradient; `content: ""`), because the font has no "≡". The `<summary>` markup stays `<summary class="site-menu-toggle">Меню</summary>`. Hide the default disclosure marker (`list-style: none` and `::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }`).
    +- **D11. One entry point for notifications.** The "Уведомления" item is removed from `templates/includes/site_nav_items.html`. The header button replaces it at every width, so the page has one notifications link and one counter instead of three. The button has `aria-current="page"` on `/notifications/`.
    +- **D12. "Все уведомления" link removed** from the home page. Reason: the header button and both card-title links already lead to the feed. A fourth link to the same page adds a tap target and no value, and the mockup has none.
    +- **D13. Stars.** Pure CSS (for example `body::before` or `.site-header::before` with `box-shadow` pixels in `--color-star-yellow`/`--color-star-lilac`), `content: ""` (pseudo-elements are not exposed to assistive technology), `pointer-events: none`, below the content (`z-index`). Only in the header area and in the side margins. Never over text or controls at 320, 360 and 1024 px. You choose the positions.
    +- **D14. Tap targets** ≥ 44×44 px: buttons, the menu toggle, the notifications button, menu items, floor switcher links (already), card-row title links (row height ≥ 44 px), the home action buttons, the file input button, the error-page button. Links inside running text are exempt (WCAG 2.5.8 inline exception).
    +- **D15. No transitions or animations.** If you add any `transition` or `animation`, also add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` that turns them off (test T-D7).
    +- **D16. Forms.** Light text on a dark field: `--color-field-bg` background, `--color-text` text, 3 px `--color-field-border` border, square corners, body font, minimum height 44 px. `input[type=file]::file-selector-button` gets the panel button look. `.errorlist` and `.message--error` use `--color-warn-text`. `.form` (also used for the login form, the staff queue filter, the announcement form and the chat form) is a panel with the double frame.
    +- **D17. Chat.** `.chat-message--own` and `.chat-message--other` look different in more than colour. Keep the existing side margins (base.css); also use a different frame or background tint (for example `--color-now-bg` on own messages). The meta line ("Вы", "Деканат · …", the student name) stays.
    +- **D18. Error templates.** 403 and 404 extend `base.html`. 500 is standalone: Django renders it with an empty context and the database may be down, so it must not extend `base.html` (base runs DB-backed tags for students). It uses only `{% load static %}`, `{% static %}` and plain HTML. The button on 500 links to `/`.
    +
    +## Architecture / files
    +
    +Python (small context changes; no models, no migrations):
    +- `notifications/feed.py`: `HomeSummary` gets a `student: StudentProfile` field. `home_summary()` gets an optional `now` argument (F1).
    +- `schedule/services.py`: new `today_schedule()` (F2).
    +- `schedule/views.py`: `TodayView` uses `today_schedule()` (F3).
    +- `core/views.py`: `HomeView` adds the day schedule to the context (F4).
    +
    +Templates:
    +- `templates/base.html` (F5): favicon, new header.
    +- `templates/includes/site_nav_items.html`: remove the student "Уведомления" `<li>` (D11). Nothing else changes in it.
    +- New `templates/includes/icon_cap.html`, `templates/includes/icon_bell.html` (D9).
    +- `core/templates/core/home.html` (F6): rewritten.
    +- New `schedule/templates/schedule/includes/lesson_compact.html` (F7).
    +- `notifications/templates/notifications/feed.html`: add `id="deadlines"` to the deadlines `<section>` and `id="feed"` to the feed `<section>`. Nothing else.
    +- New `templates/403.html`, `templates/404.html`, `templates/500.html` (F8).
    +- Other page templates (see "Pages"): you may add CSS classes and wrapper elements (`<div class="card">`, `<section class="card">`) for styling. Do not change text, links, form fields, element ids, `data-*` attributes or the order of content. Every such change is listed in the REPORT.
    +
    +Static:
    +- `static/css/tokens.css`, `static/css/base.css`, `static/css/theme.css` (D1–D17).
    +- New `static/img/favicon.svg` (D9).
    +- `static/fonts/*`: unchanged. `static/js/chat.js`: unchanged.
    +
    +Docs:
    +- `README.md`: new "## Design" section (AC18), placed after "## Chat".
    +
    +Tests: see the Test plan.
    +
    +## Functions
    +
    +### F1. `notifications/feed.py`
    +
    +```python
    +@dataclass(frozen=True)
    +class HomeSummary:
    +    student: StudentProfile
    +    deadlines: list[DeadlineItem]
    +    news: list[FeedItem]
    +
    +
    +def home_summary(
    +    user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser, now: datetime | None = None
    +) -> HomeSummary | None:
    +```
    +- Purpose: also return the student profile (with `group__program` already loaded by `student_context`), so the home page needs no extra query for the group.
    +- Algorithm: `ctx = student_context(user, now)`; the rest stays. Return `HomeSummary(student=ctx.student, deadlines=deadlines, news=news)`. `StudentProfile` is already imported in this module.
    +- Callers: `core.views.HomeView` only (checked: no other caller and no test builds `HomeSummary` directly).
    +- Tests: T-F1a, T-F1b.
    +
    +### F2. `schedule/services.py`
    +
    +```python
    +def today_schedule(group_id: int, now: datetime) -> tuple[DaySchedule, TodayAnnotation]:
    +```
    +- Purpose: the shared "today" computation of the "Сегодня" page and the home page.
    +- Input: a group id and an aware datetime. Output: the day schedule for the Moscow-local date of `now`, and its annotation at the local time of `now`.
    +- Algorithm: `local = timezone.localtime(now)`; `day = day_schedule(local.date(), [group_id], today=local.date())`; `return day, annotate_today(day.items, local.time())`. Import `datetime` from `datetime` and `timezone` from `django.utils`.
    +- Edge cases: `now` just before or after Moscow midnight gives the local date (test with `now` = `2026-11-17 21:00 UTC`, which is `2026-11-18 00:00` in Moscow).
    +- Tests: T-F2a, T-F2b.
    +
    +### F3. `schedule/views.py` `TodayView.get_context_data`
    +
    +Replace the three lines that compute `now`, `day` and `annotation` with `day, annotation = today_schedule(self.profile.group_id, timezone.now())`. The context keys stay the same. Remove imports that are no longer used (`day_schedule`, `annotate_today`) only if ruff reports them. Covered by the existing schedule view tests.
    +
    +### F4. `core/views.py` `HomeView.get_context_data`
    +
    +```python
    +def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
    +    context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
    +    now = timezone.now()
    +    summary = home_summary(self.request.user, now)
    +    context["summary"] = summary
    +    if summary is not None:
    +        day, annotation = today_schedule(summary.student.group_id, now)
    +        context["day"] = day
    +        context["annotation"] = annotation
    +    return context
    +```
    +- One `now` for both services, so the date of the cards and the lessons is the same at midnight.
    +- Access: unchanged (login required by the middleware; the role switch is in the template).
    +- Tests: T-H*.

    +- Keep the skip link, `<main id="main" class="site-main">`, the messages block and the footer text unchanged (tests check them). You may add classes to them.

    +### F6. `core/templates/core/home.html`
    +
    +```django
    +{% extends "base.html" %}
    +{% block content %}
    +{% if summary %}

    +    {% else %}<p class="card-empty">Сегодня занятий нет.</p>{% endif %}

    +    {% if summary.deadlines %}<ul class="card-rows">{% for d in summary.deadlines %}

    +    {% endfor %}</ul>{% else %}<p class="card-empty">Ближайших дедлайнов нет.</p>{% endif %}

  """Candidate TASK-013 floor plans + checks. Run: python plan.py"""
  from dataclasses import dataclass

  class Rect:

  ROOM,LANDMARK,SERVICE="room","landmark","service"

  class Space:
      kind:str; label:str; parts:tuple; points:tuple=()
  OUTLINE=Rect(4,4,392,640); CORRIDOR=Rect(164,84,72,488)
  STAIRS=Rect(164,4,72,80); STAIRS_BOTTOM=Rect(164,572,72,72)
  TOILET=Rect(4,404,160,48)
  def L(y0,y1): return (4,y0,160,y1-y0)
  def R(y0,y1): return (236,y0,160,y1-y0)
  def room(n,*a): return Space(ROOM,n,(Rect(*a),))
  def lm(n,*a): return Space(LANDMARK,n,(Rect(*a),))
  def sv(n,*a): return Space(SERVICE,n,(Rect(*a),))
  ST=(Space(LANDMARK,"Лестница",(STAIRS,)),Space(LANDMARK,"Лестница",(STAIRS_BOTTOM,)))
  def toilet(f): return Space(SERVICE,"Туалет М" if f%2 else "Туалет Ж",(TOILET,))
  P={
  1:ST+(toilet(1),
   room("101",*L(4,116)),room("102",*L(116,196)),room("103",*L(196,260)),room("104",*L(260,332)),room("105",*L(332,404)),
   lm("Столовая",*L(452,644)),
   room("106",*R(4,112)),room("107",*R(112,184)),room("108",*R(184,256)),room("114",*R(256,364)),
   sv("Кафедра",*R(364,436)),sv("Медпункт",*R(436,500)),lm("Вход",*R(500,572)),
   sv("Охрана",236,572,64,72),sv("Гардероб",300,572,96,72)),
  2:ST+(toilet(2),
   lm("Деканат",*L(4,124)),room("201",*L(124,196)),room("202",*L(196,260)),room("203",*L(260,332)),room("205",*L(332,404)),
   room("206",*L(452,644)),
   room("207",*R(4,112)),room("208",*R(112,188)),
   Space(ROOM,"210",(Rect(236,188,160,128),Rect(236,316,80,96)),((236,188),(396,188),(396,316),(316,316),(316,412),(236,412))),
   room("211",316,316,80,96),room("212",*R(412,532)),sv("Кафедра",*R(532,644))),
  3:ST+(toilet(3),
   room("301",*L(4,124)),room("302",*L(124,188)),room("303",*L(188,252)),room("304",*L(252,332)),room("305",*L(332,404)),
   room("306",*L(452,548)),room("308",*L(548,644)),
   lm("Библиотека",*R(4,204)),room("310",*R(204,308)),room("312",*R(308,428)),sv("Кафедра",*R(428,532)),room("315",*R(532,644))),
  4:ST+(toilet(4),
   room("401",*L(4,132)),room("402",*L(132,204)),room("403",*L(204,268)),room("404",*L(268,332)),room("405",*L(332,404)),
   room("406",*L(452,644)),
   room("407",*R(4,116)),room("408",*R(116,212)),room("409",*R(212,356)),sv("Кафедра",*R(356,452)),room("410",*R(452,548)),sv("Архив",*R(548,644))),
  }
  def inter(a,b):
      w=min(a.x+a.width,b.x+b.width)-max(a.x,b.x); h=min(a.y+a.height,b.y+b.height)-max(a.y,b.y)
      return w*h if w>0 and h>0 else 0
  def shared(a,b):
      """Length of the common boundary of two non-overlapping rects."""
      if a.x+a.width==b.x or b.x+b.width==a.x:
          return max(0,min(a.y+a.height,b.y+b.height)-max(a.y,b.y))
      if a.y+a.height==b.y or b.y+b.height==a.y:
          return max(0,min(a.x+a.width,b.x+b.width)-max(a.x,b.x))
      return 0
  def shared_space(s,rects): return max(shared(p,r) for p in s.parts for r in rects)

      assert sum(p.area for p in parts)==OUTLINE.area-CORRIDOR.area,(f,sum(p.area for p in parts))
      for i,a in enumerate(parts):

      entr=[p for s in sp if s.label=="Вход" for p in s.parts]

  print('ALL OK' if ok else 'VIOLATIONS')

    +# TASK-013: Floor plans v3, final map look, no change reasons, small UI fixes
    +
    +Assignee: **UI coder** (thr_pgcwc2dwnn). Request: Team lead, approved by the user.
    +
    +## Goal
    +
    +1. Make the floor plans plausible: two staircases, no storage rooms, a separate wardrobe and a small security post at a moved entrance, one toilet per floor (М/Ж alternating), and a door from every room to the corridor.
    +2. Give the map its final look: an orange highlighted room, distinct landmarks and service spaces, a room list of pixel buttons.
    +3. Stop showing the reasons of lesson changes anywhere. The field stays in the database and the admin and becomes optional.
    +4. Fix three small UI defects: the file input text is cut, the wide header wraps at 1024 px, and the scrollbar is not themed.
    +
    +## Acceptance criteria
    +
    +Floor plans (`university/building.py`):
    +- AC1. No space is labelled "Склад" on any floor.
    +- AC2. Every floor has exactly two "Лестница" landmarks: one at `STAIRS` `Rect(164, 4, 72, 80)` (the top end of the corridor) and one at `STAIRS_BOTTOM` `Rect(164, 572, 72, 72)` (the bottom end). The constant `BOTTOM_CENTRE` is removed.
    +- AC3. "Вход" exists only on floor 1. It is a landmark next to the corridor, at the outer east wall: `Rect(236, 500, 160, 72)` (D1).
    +- AC4. "Гардероб" (`Rect(308, 572, 88, 72)`) and "Охрана" (`Rect(236, 572, 72, 72)`) on floor 1 are separate service spaces next to the entrance. "Охрана" has 45% of its old area (5184 instead of 11520). "Столовая" is one rectangle `Rect(4, 452, 160, 192)`, not a polygon. The only multi-part space left is room 210.
    +- AC5. **Access rule.** Every room shares a wall of at least `DOOR_MIN = 24` units with the corridor, except the rooms in `INNER_ROOMS = {"211"}`. Every landmark and service space, except the two staircases, shares a wall of at least 24 units with the corridor or with the "Вход" space (D2).
    +- AC6. Toilets: exactly one service space per floor whose label starts with "Туалет". It is "Туалет М" on floors 1 and 3 and "Туалет Ж" on floors 2 and 4. All four are at the same `TOILET = Rect(4, 404, 160, 48)` (one riser).
    +- AC7.     +## Design decisions
    +
    +- **D1. Entrance.** The bottom end of the corridor now holds the second staircase, so the entrance moves to the east wing, next to the corridor (`Rect(236, 500, 160, 72)`, the old "Склад" and lower "Медпункт" area). Visitors enter from the outer east wall straight into the corridor. The bottom-right corner below the entrance (y 572–644) is split into "Охрана" (a small post, 72 wide) and "Гардероб" (88 wide). Both open onto the entrance hall. The wardrobe is next to the entrance, not inside the canteen. The canteen takes the full bottom of the west wing.
    +- **D2. Door rule.** "Shares a wall" means a common boundary segment of at least `DOOR_MIN = 24` user units. The corridor is 72 units wide (about 3 m), so 24 units is about 1 m: a door fits. A shorter contact (for example 8 or 16 units, as 206, 207 and 308 have today) is not a door. Under this rule the current plans also break it at rooms 206 (8 units), 207 and 308 (16 units). The new plans fix them as well. Rooms are split along the corridor: every space in a wing is a full-width horizontal strip, except the 210/211 pair (211 is the inner room of 210, a user decision) and the Охрана/Гардероб pair (they open onto the entrance).
    +- **D3. Toilets in one riser.** `TOILET = Rect(4, 404, 160, 48)` on every floor. The label is "Туалет М" (odd floors) or "Туалет Ж" (even floors).

    +## Functions
    +
    +There are no new production functions. The changes are data, templates, CSS and one model field. New test helpers (private, in `university/tests/test_building.py`):
    +
    +```python
    +def _shared_wall(a: Rect, b: Rect) -> int:
    +```
    +- Length of the common boundary of two non-overlapping rectangles: if `a.x + a.width == b.x` or `b.x + b.width == a.x`, return `max(0, min(a.y + a.height, b.y + b.height) - max(a.y, b.y))`; elif `a.y + a.height == b.y` or `b.y + b.height == a.y`, return the same for x; else 0.
    +- Unit tests: `test_shared_wall_helper` (side by side 40 units → 40; corner touch → 0; apart → 0; above/below with 24 overlap → 24).
    +
    +```python
    +def _space_wall(space: Space, rects: list[Rect]) -> int:
    +```
    +- `max((_shared_wall(p, r) for p in space.parts for r in rects), default=0)`.

1. (User decision 18.11, raised by the Planner in TASK-013 "Risks".) A reason-only edit of a `LessonChange` must not make the change unread again.
   - Facts: `schedule/models.py` `LessonChange.updated_at = DateTimeField(auto_now=True)`; `notifications/sources.py` `LessonChangeSource.event_field = "updated_at"` (unread = updated_at > seen_until).
   - Scenario today: staff edits only `reason` in the admin or via `save_lesson_change` -> `updated_at` moves -> the feed item is "Новое" and the badge +1, but the student sees no difference.
   - Required: the feed timestamp moves only when a field visible to students changes (kind, original_date, weekly_lesson, new_date, new_slot, new_room, new_teacher). Existing changes keep their current read/unread state after the migration. Choose the design (e.g. a separate `changed_at` field set on visible changes, data migration copying `updated_at`, `event_field = "changed_at"`); cover the admin save path and `save_lesson_change`.
   - Tests: change `notifications/tests/test_feed.py::test_edited_change_is_new_again` to edit a visible field; add a regression test "reason-only edit does not make the change unread" (admin path and service path); test that the data migration keeps the unread state.
2. Test runner leaks uploads with `--parallel` on macOS (found by the Team lead on 18.11).
   - Facts: `core/test_runner.py` `ProjectTestRunner.setup_test_environment` applies `override_settings(PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT=<temp dir>)` in the parent process only. On macOS the parallel runner starts workers with "spawn"; workers re-import settings, so `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT` falls back to `BASE_DIR / "private_media"` (`config/settings.py`, env `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT`).
   - Effect: `python manage.py test --parallel` wrote 81 test PDFs into the project's `private_media/` and failed `core.tests.test_storage.TestRunnerTests.test_test_runner_uses_temp_dir` (run 18.11 ~16:42 MSK, `AssertionError: PosixPath('<project>') unexpectedly found in <PosixPath.parents>`). Serial runs and CI (Linux, fork) pass.
   - Required: every test process (parent and spawned workers) uses the temporary private media directory; the directory is removed after the run. Keep the current serial behaviour. E.g. set the env variable `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT` in the runner before workers start, or re-apply the override in the worker initializer — choose and justify.
   - Tests: a test that proves a spawned worker gets the temp directory (or a documented reproducible check with `--parallel 2` in the Verification section, run on macOS), plus the existing test passing in both modes.

    from university.models import StudyGroup

    from .guards import run_change_guards
    from .models import LessonChange, WeeklyLesson
    from .validation import restored_occurrence_conflicts, validate_weekly_lesson


    def save_weekly_lesson(lesson: WeeklyLesson, groups: Sequence[StudyGroup]) -> WeeklyLesson:
        with transaction.atomic():
            lesson.full_clean()
            errors = validate_weekly_lesson(
                weekday=lesson.weekday,
                slot=lesson.slot,
                valid_from=lesson.valid_from,
                valid_until=lesson.valid_until,
                room_id=lesson.room_id,
                group_ids=[g.pk for g in groups],
                exclude_pk=lesson.pk,
            )
            if errors:
                raise ValidationError(errors)
            lesson.save()
            lesson.groups.set(groups)
            return lesson


    def save_lesson_change(change: LessonChange) -> LessonChange:
        with transaction.atomic():
            change.full_clean()
            change.save()
            return change


    def delete_lesson_change(change: LessonChange) -> None:
        with transaction.atomic():
            errors = restored_occurrence_conflicts(change) + run_change_guards(change, deleting=True)
            if errors:
                raise ValidationError(errors)
            change.delete()

        This helper lives at module-level because of the multiprocessing module's
        requirements.
        """

        global _worker_id

        with counter.get_lock():

        start_method = multiprocessing.get_start_method()

    class ParallelTestSuite(unittest.TestSuite):
        """
        Run a series of tests in parallel in several processes.

        While the unittest module's documentation implies that orchestrating the
        execution of tests is the responsibility of the test runner, in practice,
        it appears that TestRunner classes are more concerned with formatting and
        displaying test results.

        Since there are fewer use cases for customizing TestSuite than TestRunner,
        implementing parallelization at the level of the TestSuite improves
        interoperability with existing custom test runners. A single instance of a
        test runner can still collect results from all tests without being aware
        that they have been run in parallel.
        """

        # In case someone wants to modify these in a subclass.
        init_worker = _init_worker
        process_setup = _process_setup_stub
        process_setup_args = ()
        run_subsuite = _run_subsuite
        runner_class = RemoteTestRunner

        def __init__(
            self, subsuites, processes, failfast=False, debug_mode=False, buffer=False
        ):
            self.subsuites = subsuites
            self.processes = processes
            self.failfast = failfast
            self.debug_mode = debug_mode
            self.buffer = buffer
            self.initial_settings = None
            self.serialized_contents = None
            self.used_aliases = None
            super().__init__()

        def run(self, result):
            """
            Distribute TestCases across workers.

            Return an identifier of each TestCase with its result in order to use
            imap_unordered to show results as soon as they're available.

            To minimize pickling errors when getting results from workers:

            - pass back numeric indexes in self.subsuites instead of tests
            - make tracebacks picklable with tblib, if available

            Even with tblib, errors may still occur for dynamically created
            exception classes which cannot be unpickled.
            """
            self.initialize_suite()
            counter = multiprocessing.Value(ctypes.c_int, 0)
            pool = multiprocessing.Pool(
                processes=self.processes,
                initializer=self.init_worker.__func__,
                initargs=[
                    counter,
                    self.initial_settings,
                    self.serialized_contents,
                    self.process_setup.__func__,
                    self.process_setup_args,
                    self.debug_mode,
                    self.used_aliases,
                ],
            )
            args = [
                (self.runner_class, index, subsuite, self.failfast, self.buffer)
                for index, subsuite in enumerate(self.subsuites)
            ]
            test_results = pool.imap_unordered(self.run_subsuite.__func__, args)

            while True:

        def __iter__(self):
            return iter(self.subsuites)

        def initialize_suite(self):
            if multiprocessing.get_start_method() == "spawn":
                self.initial_settings = {
                    alias: connections[alias].settings_dict for alias in connections
                }
                self.serialized_contents = {
                    alias: connections[alias]._test_serialized_contents
                    for alias in connections
                    if alias in self.serialized_aliases
                }
