  class BackupScriptRunTests(SimpleTestCase):
      """TASK-016: run backup.sh with a stub pg_dump; the password never reaches the command line."""

      PASSWORD = "0123abcd4567ef89dummydbpass"

      def test_password_not_on_command_line(self):
          bash = shutil.which("bash")
          if bash is None or shutil.which("tar") is None or shutil.which("gzip") is None:
              self.skipTest("bash, tar or gzip not available")
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
              root = Path(tmp)
              (root / "bin").mkdir()
              (root / "media" / "private_media").mkdir(parents=True)
              (root / "media" / "private_media" / "a.pdf").write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4")
              stub = root / "bin" / "pg_dump"
              stub.write_text(
                  "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n"
                  f'printf "%s\\n" "$@" > "{root}/args"\n'
                  f'env | grep -E "^PG(USER|PASSWORD|HOST|PORT|DATABASE)=" | sort > "{root}/pgenv"\n'
                  f'env | grep -c "^DATABASE_URL=" > "{root}/dburl" || true\n'
                  'echo "-- dump"\n',
                  encoding="utf-8",
              )
              stub.chmod(0o755)
              env_file = root / "deanery.env"
              env_file.write_text(
                  f"DATABASE_URL=postgres://deanery:{self.PASSWORD}@localhost:5432/deanery_trial\n"
                  f"PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT={root}/media/private_media\n",
                  encoding="utf-8",
              )
              env = {
                  "PATH": f"{root / 'bin'}{os.pathsep}{os.environ['PATH']}",
                  "BACKUP_DIR": str(root / "backups"),
                  "DEANERY_ENV_FILE": str(env_file),
              }
              result = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603
                  [bash, str(BACKUP_SH)], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
              )
              self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
              self.assertIn("backup ok:", result.stdout)
              args = (root / "args").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
              self.assertNotIn(self.PASSWORD, args)
              self.assertEqual(args.split(), ["--no-owner", "--no-privileges"])
              self.assertEqual(
                  (root / "pgenv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split(),
                  [
                      "PGDATABASE=deanery_trial",
                      "PGHOST=localhost",
                      f"PGPASSWORD={self.PASSWORD}",
                      "PGPORT=5432",
                      "PGUSER=deanery",
                  ],
              )
              self.assertEqual((root / "dburl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip(), "0")
              names = sorted(p.name for p in (root / "backups").iterdir())
              self.assertEqual(len(names), 2)
              self.assertTrue(names[0].startswith("db-") and names[0].endswith(".sql.gz"))
              self.assertTrue(names[1].startswith("media-") and names[1].endswith(".tar.gz"))

              result = subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603

              )
              self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)

  """TASK-016: Content-Security-Policy and no-store for signed-in users (PT1-F3, PT1-F5)."""

  import re
  from pathlib import Path

  from django.conf import settings
  from django.http import HttpResponse
  from django.test import RequestFactory, SimpleTestCase, TestCase, override_settings
  from django.urls import reverse

  from accounts.models import User
  from accounts.tests.helpers import make_faculty, make_group, make_staff, make_student
  from core.middleware import (
      CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY,
      ContentSecurityPolicyMiddleware,
      PrivateCacheMiddleware,
  )

  EXPECTED_CSP = (
      "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; "
      "font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; "
      "form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'"
  )


  class ContentSecurityPolicyTests(TestCase):
      @classmethod
      def setUpTestData(cls):
          fac = make_faculty("FX")
          group = make_group(fac, "GX")
          cls.student = make_student("csp_student", group, "SA")
          cls.staff = make_staff("csp_staff", fac)
          cls.admin = User.objects.create_superuser("csp_admin", password="Admin-Pass-2026!")

      def test_policy_value(self):
          self.assertEqual(CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY, EXPECTED_CSP)

      def test_anonymous_login_page(self):
          response = self.client.get(reverse("accounts:login"))
          self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], EXPECTED_CSP)

      def test_student_page(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.student)
          response = self.client.get(reverse("accounts:profile"))
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
          self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], EXPECTED_CSP)

      def test_staff_page(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.staff)
          response = self.client.get(reverse("petitions:staff_queue"))
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
          self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], EXPECTED_CSP)

      def test_admin_page_same_policy(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.admin)
          response = self.client.get(reverse("admin:index"))
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
          self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], EXPECTED_CSP)

      def test_redirect_and_404(self):
          self.assertEqual(
              self.client.get("/grades/")["Content-Security-Policy"], EXPECTED_CSP
          )
          self.client.force_login(self.student)
          response = self.client.get("/no-such-page/")
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
          self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], EXPECTED_CSP)

      @override_settings(DEBUG=True)
      def test_debug_error_pages_without_policy(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.student)
          response = self.client.get("/no-such-page/")
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)
          self.assertNotIn("Content-Security-Policy", response)

      def test_existing_header_kept(self):
          def view(request):
              response = HttpResponse("x")
              response["Content-Security-Policy"] = "default-src 'none'"
              return response

          response = ContentSecurityPolicyMiddleware(view)(RequestFactory().get("/x/"))
          self.assertEqual(response["Content-Security-Policy"], "default-src 'none'")


  class TemplatesFitPolicyTests(SimpleTestCase):
      """The strict policy works only while templates stay free of inline code."""

      FORBIDDEN = (
          re.compile(r"<script(?![^>]*\ssrc=)[^>]*>", re.IGNORECASE),
          re.compile(r"<style", re.IGNORECASE),
          re.compile(r"\sstyle\s*=", re.IGNORECASE),
          re.compile(r"\son[a-z]+\s*=", re.IGNORECASE),
          re.compile(r"javascript:", re.IGNORECASE),
          re.compile(r"""(?:src|href)\s*=\s*["']?(?:https?:)?//""", re.IGNORECASE),
          re.compile(r"data:image", re.IGNORECASE),
      )

      def test_no_inline_code_in_templates(self):
          base = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
          paths = sorted(base.glob("templates/**/*.html")) + sorted(
              base.glob("*/templates/**/*.html")
          )
          self.assertGreater(len(paths), 30)
          for path in paths:
              text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
              for pattern in self.FORBIDDEN:
                  self.assertIsNone(pattern.search(text), f"{path.relative_to(base)}: {pattern}")


  class PrivateCacheTests(TestCase):
      @classmethod
      def setUpTestData(cls):
          fac = make_faculty("FX")
          group = make_group(fac, "GX")
          cls.student = make_student("cache_student", group, "SA")
          cls.staff = make_staff("cache_staff", fac)

      def _assert_no_store(self, response):
          cache_control = response["Cache-Control"]
          self.assertIn("no-store", cache_control)
          self.assertIn("private", cache_control)

      def test_student_pages_no_store(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.student)
          for name in ("accounts:profile", "academics:grades", "schedule:week"):
              response = self.client.get(reverse(name))
              self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, name)
              self._assert_no_store(response)

      def test_staff_page_no_store(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.staff)
          self._assert_no_store(self.client.get(reverse("petitions:staff_queue")))

      def test_anonymous_unchanged(self):
          response = self.client.get("/grades/")
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
          self.assertNotIn("Cache-Control", response)

      def test_stale_session_cookie_unchanged(self):
          self.client.cookies[settings.SESSION_COOKIE_NAME] = "no-such-session"
          response = self.client.get("/grades/")
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
          self.assertNotIn("Cache-Control", response)

      def test_no_session_access_without_cookie(self):
          request = RequestFactory().get("/x/")
          response = PrivateCacheMiddleware(lambda r: HttpResponse("x"))(request)
          self.assertNotIn("Cache-Control", response)
          self.assertFalse(hasattr(request, "user"))

      def test_session_length_unchanged(self):
          self.assertEqual(settings.SESSION_COOKIE_AGE, 14 * 24 * 3600)

    +# TASK-016: security hardening from PENTEST-1
    +
    +Author: Planner. Assignee: Coder. Status: ready for implementation.
    +Base: HEAD 851b3ee (clean tree except the Team lead's `plan.md`; do not touch it).
    +Source: `docs/security/PENTEST-1.md` (findings PT1-F1 … PT1-F13).
    +
    +## 1. Goal
    +
    +Close the PENTEST-1 findings the user decided to fix. No Critical/High findings exist; this is hardening.
    +
    +### Acceptance criteria
    +
    +| ID | Finding | Criterion |
    +|---|---|---|
    +| AC1 | PT1-F1 | nginx limits `POST` requests to every path that ends in `/login/` (the site login and the admin login under any `ADMIN_URL`) to 10 per minute per client IP, burst 10, answer 429. GET requests are not limited. A site-wide limit of 20 concurrent requests per client IP answers 429. The `proxy_set_header` lines are at the `server` level, so every `location` inherits them. |
    +| AC2 | PT1-F2 | The login lockout key for an IPv6 client is its /64 network address (e.g. `2001:db8:1:2::`); IPv4 is unchanged; an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address counts as its IPv4 address. No per-account lock across addresses (plan.md 6b). |
    +| AC3 | PT1-F4 | nginx has catch-all `default_server` blocks: port 80 → `return 444`; port 443 → `ssl_reject_handshake on`. HTTP for the domain and `www` serves ACME and redirects with 301 to `https://<domain>$request_uri` (never `$host`). HTTPS `www` redirects with 301 to the domain. The bootstrap config answers ACME for both names. The runbook issues the certificate with `-d "$DOMAIN" -d "www.$DOMAIN"`. |
    +| AC4 | PT1-F3 | Every response to a signed-in user has `Cache-Control` with `no-store` and `private` (Django's `add_never_cache_headers`). Responses to requests without a session cookie and static files are unchanged. `SESSION_COOKIE_AGE` stays 14 days. |
    +| AC5 | PT1-F5 | Every response that passes Django's middleware carries exactly this header (admin included): `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'`. Exceptions: a response that already has the header keeps it; with `DEBUG=True`, responses with status ≥ 400 get no header (Django's technical error pages). No new dependency. |
    +| AC6 | PT1-F7 | `RequestType.comment_hint` is HTML-escaped before it becomes the `help_text` of the comment field. |
    +| AC7 | PT1-F8 | `?type=` on the staff queue is used only if it is 1–18 ASCII digits; any other value (also 19+ digits) is ignored like a non-numeric value. No HTTP 500. All other integer inputs are already safe (section 5, item 6) and get regression tests. |
    +| AC8 | PT1-F10 | The chat idempotency token is looked up per author; the unique constraint becomes (`dialog`, `author`, `client_token`); migration `chat/0002_message_token_per_author`. |
    +| AC9 | PT1-F13 | `deploy/backup.sh` passes the database password to `pg_dump` through the libpq environment, never on the command line; other behaviour is unchanged. `deploy/gunicorn.conf.py`: `secure_scheme_headers = {"X-FORWARDED-PROTO": "https"}`. `deploy/systemd/deanery.service`: `ProtectSystem=strict` and the sandbox options listed in F11. `docs/DEPLOY.md`: `DEMO_PASSWORD` is removed from the env file right after the one-time `seed_demo` on 2026-11-22. |
    +| AC10 | PT1-F6 (part) | The runbook creates the service account with `--shell /usr/sbin/nologin` and has no SSH key step for it. A new runbook step 21 hardens a server installed before this task. |
    +| AC11 | — | CI runs `pip-audit --requirement requirements.txt` in its own step with `pip-audit==2.10.1`, not in any requirements file. Nothing to fix today (section 5, item 9). |
    +| AC12 | — | Full suite, `--parallel 2`, `run_tests_at.py`, ruff, `bash -n`, `gunicorn --check-config`, CI YAML, `makemigrations --check` all pass. |
    +
    +## 2. Out of scope
    +
    +- Accepted by the user: PT1-F6 rest, PT1-F9, PT1-F11, PT1-F12, TLS cipher list and OCSP, the HSTS raise.
    +- Not requested: rejecting superusers in the public login form (PT1-F2 point 3), a per-username limit across
    +  addresses (forbidden, plan.md 6b), shorter sessions, a `DisallowedHost` null logger (PT1-F4; the catch-all
    +  servers keep foreign hosts away from Django), `psql "$DATABASE_URL"` in the manual restore command.
    +- `plan.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, `docs/security/*`, old specs.
    +
    +## 3. Design decisions
    +
    +- **D1. Login rate limit by path pattern, not by the admin path.** The limited location is the regex
    +  `^/(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/)*login/$`. It matches `/login/` and `/<ADMIN_URL>login/` for every valid `ADMIN_URL`
    +  (`config/env_utils.py:33` allows `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*`). This differs from the request ("the
    +  runbook renders the admin path") on purpose: the secret admin path does not go into `/etc/nginx` (world-readable),
    +  the template needs no extra placeholder, and a changed `ADMIN_URL` needs no nginx change. The only other paths
    +  the pattern matches do not exist (404 from Django).
    +- **D2. Only POST is counted, burst 10.** A `map` gives an empty key for every method except POST; nginx does not
    +  count requests with an empty key. So loading the login page never costs a slot, and jurors behind one NAT
    +  address can sign in together (10 at once, then one per 6 s). One failed login costs ≈ 0.2 s CPU (PENTEST-1), so
    +  one address can use at most ≈ 3 % of one CPU after the burst.
    +- **D3. limit_conn 20** per address for the whole HTTPS site (HTTP/2 counts every active stream). A page loads
    +  ≈ 7 files; static responses take milliseconds.
    +- **D4. Zones in the site file.** `map`, `limit_req_zone` and `limit_conn_zone` must be in the `http` context.
    +  Ubuntu's `nginx.conf` includes `sites-enabled/*` inside `http {}`, so they stay in `deploy/nginx/deanery.conf`;
    +  no change to the stock `nginx.conf`.
    +- **D5. Catch-all 443 with `ssl_reject_handshake on`** (nginx ≥ 1.19.4; Ubuntu 24.04 has 1.24): no certificate in
    +  that block, the TLS handshake for an unknown SNI or no SNI fails, so the domain is not revealed for the IP. Both
    +  catch-all blocks use the same `listen` options as the domain blocks (`ssl http2`), the 1.24 syntax the existing
    +  test requires. The stock `default` site is already removed in step 12 (two `default_server` on one port would
    +  fail `nginx -t`).
    +- **D6. One CSP for the whole site, the admin included.** Measured (section 5, item 4): with the strict policy,
    +  69 Django admin pages (every model's list, first change page, add page; date, time, `filter_horizontal`,
    +  inline "add row" widgets clicked) and 40 student + 40 staff pages give zero CSP violations in Chrome. Django 5.2's
    +  admin has no inline scripts (`<script id=… src=…>` only) and its single inline `<style>` (`change_list.html:16`)
    +  renders only when a `ModelAdmin` sets both `actions_on_top` and `actions_on_bottom` to false — none does. Admin
    +  JavaScript changes styles through CSSOM (`el.style.x = …`), which CSP allows. So no relaxed admin policy is
    +  needed. If a future admin page needs it, the fallback is `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` for the admin path
    +  only (scripts stay strict).
    +- **D7. No `data:` in `img-src`.** No template, CSS or JS of the project uses a `data:` URI (grep, section 5,
    +  item 4); the favicon is `static/img/favicon.svg`, the logo and the bell are inline SVG markup (allowed). CSS
    +  `url(#map-hatch)` refers to an element in the page, not a fetch.
    +- **D8. CSP middleware position:** right after WhiteNoise. WhiteNoise answers static files before it, so static
    +  files are unchanged; every Django response (views, redirects of `LoginRequiredMiddleware`, CSRF 403, 404/500)
    +  passes through it. With `DEBUG=True` responses with status ≥ 400 are skipped because Django's technical pages
    +  use inline CSS/JS; production has `DEBUG=False`.
    +- **D9. no-store middleware position:** last in `MIDDLEWARE` (after authentication). It returns early when the
    +  request has no session cookie, so it never touches the session of anonymous requests (no new `Vary: Cookie`).
    +  It uses `add_never_cache_headers` (the same headers as the existing `never_cache` views). Chrome check: after
    +  logout, Back shows the login page, not `/grades/` (section 5, item 5).
    +- **D10. IPv6 key = network address of the /64** (`str(IPv6Network((addr, 64), strict=False).network_address)`),
    +  a valid IP for the existing `GenericIPAddressField` (`inet` on PostgreSQL): no migration. The new function
    +  `throttle_ip()` is applied in the form; `get_client_ip()` stays unchanged (its tests stay).
    +- **D11. Type filter by regex**, the same pattern as the chat `after` parameter (`chat/views.py:34`): 1–18 ASCII
    +  digits always fit the 64-bit id range of SQLite and PostgreSQL. `[0-9]` (not `\d`) rejects non-ASCII digits.
    +- **D12. Chat token per author** needs the constraint change: with the old (`dialog`, `client_token`) constraint a
    +  staff reply that reuses a student's token would raise `IntegrityError` (HTTP 500) instead of being silently
    +  dropped. Existing rows satisfy the new, wider constraint (checked on a seeded database).
    +- **D13. backup.sh: libpq environment.** The script parses `DATABASE_URL` (`postgres://user:pass@host:port/name`,
    +  the format of `.env.production.example`; the password is hex from `openssl rand -hex 24`) and exports
    +  `PGUSER PGPASSWORD PGHOST PGPORT PGDATABASE`, then runs `pg_dump --no-owner --no-privileges` without a URL and
    +  unsets `DATABASE_URL`. On Linux the environment of a process is readable only by its owner and root
    +  (`/proc/<pid>/environ`), the command line by everybody (`ps`). A URL that does not match stops the script with a
    +  clear message before any file is written. A new optional variable `DEANERY_ENV_FILE` (default
    +  `/etc/deanery/deanery.env`) lets the tests run the real script with a stub `pg_dump`.
    +- **D14. systemd sandbox: what the app writes at run time.** (a) Uploads into `PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT`
    +  (`core/storage.py`) — the two directories in `ReadWritePaths`. (b) Temporary files: Django spools uploads larger
    +  than 2.5 MB to `tempfile.gettempdir()` (`/tmp`), gunicorn's worker heartbeat files go to `/tmp` — `PrivateTmp=true`
    +  gives a private writable `/tmp` even with `ProtectSystem=strict`. (c) Logs go to stdout/stderr (journald) —
    +  file descriptors opened by systemd. (d) The database over TCP `localhost:5432` (`AF_INET`/`AF_INET6`). Nothing
    +  else: sessions, cache (local memory), static files (collected before, read-only), `.pyc` files (written by
    +  `manage.sh` runs outside the unit; a failed write of `__pycache__` is silent). Grep evidence in section 5,
    +  item 7. Port 8000 needs no capability, so `CapabilityBoundingSet=` is empty. `ReadWritePaths` directories must
    +  exist (step 6 creates both).
    +- **D15. pip-audit pinned in the CI step** (2.10.1, 2026-06-10, Python ≥ 3.10). It is not in
    +  `requirements-dev.txt`, so local environments stay small. It resolves `requirements.txt` in its own temporary
    +  environment.

    +## 9. Risks
    +
    +- **nginx config not validated by nginx here** (section 5, item 11). Mitigation: `nginx -t` before reload in
    +  step 21; the old site file stays in place until `tee` overwrites it — keep a copy first
    +  (`sudo cp /etc/nginx/sites-available/deanery /root/deanery.nginx.bak`).
    +- **`ProtectSystem=strict` blocks an unknown write** → the unit fails or uploads fail. Mitigation: D14 list;
    +  step 21 uploads and downloads a PDF after the restart; rollback = previous unit file.
    +- **CSP breaks an untested admin widget** → the fallback in D6.
    +- **429 for jurors behind one NAT** if more than 10 sign in within seconds (D2) — they retry after 6 s.
    +- **pip-audit reports a new advisory later** → CI turns red; that is the purpose; fix by upgrading the pin.

**Что сделает Кодер:**

- **Чужие хосты и `www` (PT1-F4).** Запросы по IP и с чужим доменом nginx закрывает без ответа. `www` перенаправляет на основной домен, сертификат выпускается на оба имени.
- **Кэш (PT1-F3).** Страницы вошедшего пользователя не сохраняются в браузере. Я проверил в Chrome: после выхода кнопка «Назад» открывает вход, а не оценки.

- **Мелкие исправления.**
  - Подсказка к комментарию экранируется.
  - Огромное число в фильтре `?type=` больше не даёт ошибку 500.

  cat > petitions/wording.py <<'EOF'
  """Russian wording that agrees with the kind of a document (TASK-017).

  A certificate is "справка" (feminine), an application is "заявление" (neuter).
  Where kinds are mixed the generic noun is "документ" (masculine): the plain
  ``PetitionStatus`` labels.
  """

  from petitions.models import PetitionStatus, RequestKind

  CERTIFICATE = RequestKind.CERTIFICATE.value
  APPLICATION = RequestKind.APPLICATION.value

  STATUS_LABELS = {
      CERTIFICATE: {
          "submitted": "Подана",
          "in_progress": "В работе",
          "ready": "Готова",
          "issued": "Выдана",
          "rejected": "Отклонена",
      },
      APPLICATION: {
          "submitted": "Подано",
          "in_progress": "В работе",
          "ready": "Готово",
          "issued": "Выдано",
          "rejected": "Отклонено",
      },
  }

  ACTION_LABELS = {
      CERTIFICATE: {
          "in_progress": "Взять в работу",
          "ready": "Отметить готовой",
          "issued": "Отметить выданной",
          "rejected": "Отклонить",
      },
      APPLICATION: {
          "in_progress": "Взять в работу",
          "ready": "Отметить готовым",
          "issued": "Отметить выданным",
          "rejected": "Отклонить",
      },
  }

  TEXTS = {
      CERTIFICATE: {
          "noun": "Справка",
          "submit": "Заказать справку",
          "submitted_title": "Справка заказана",
          "back_link": "К справке",
          "comment_required": "Для этой справки комментарий обязателен.",
          "subject_example": "Справка о периоде обучения",
      },
      APPLICATION: {
          "noun": "Заявление",
          "submit": "Подать заявление",
          "submitted_title": "Заявление подано",
          "back_link": "К заявлению",
          "comment_required": "Для этого заявления комментарий обязателен.",
          "subject_example": "Заявление на индивидуальный учебный план",
      },
  }

  NOTIFICATION_TITLES = {
      CERTIFICATE: {
          "in_progress": "«{name}» взята в работу",
          "ready": "«{name}» готова — заберите её в деканате",
          "issued": "«{name}» выдана",
          "rejected": "«{name}» отклонена",
      },
      APPLICATION: {
          "in_progress": "«{name}» взято в работу",
          "ready": "«{name}» готово — заберите его в деканате",
          "issued": "«{name}» выдано",
          "rejected": "«{name}» отклонено",
      },
  }

  DOCUMENT_FORMS = ("документ", "документа", "документов")


  def _kind(kind: str) -> str:
      return kind if kind in TEXTS else CERTIFICATE


  def status_label(status: str, kind: str) -> str:
      labels = STATUS_LABELS.get(kind)
      if labels is not None and status in labels:
          return labels[status]
      return dict(PetitionStatus.choices).get(status, status)


  def action_label(status: str, kind: str) -> str:
      return ACTION_LABELS[_kind(kind)][status]


  def text(kind: str, key: str) -> str:
      return TEXTS[_kind(kind)][key]


  def notification_title(status: str, kind: str, name: str) -> str:
      template = NOTIFICATION_TITLES[_kind(kind)].get(status)
      if template is None:
          return f"«{name}»: статус «{status_label(status, kind)}»"
      return template.format(name=name)


  def plural_ru(n: int, forms: tuple[str, str, str]) -> str:
      """Russian plural: (1 документ, 2 документа, 5 документов)."""
      if n % 10 == 1 and n % 100 != 11:
          return forms[0]
      if 2 <= n % 10 <= 4 and not 12 <= n % 100 <= 14:
          return forms[1]
      return forms[2]
  EOF

  """Template filters for kind-aware wording (TASK-017)."""

  from django import template

  from petitions import wording

  register = template.Library()


  @register.filter
  def status_for(status: str, kind: str) -> str:
      """{{ petition.status|status_for:petition.request_type.kind }}"""
      return wording.status_label(status, kind)


  @register.filter
  def kind_text(kind: str, key: str) -> str:
      """{{ request_type.kind|kind_text:"submit" }}"""
      return wording.text(kind, key)
  EOF

    def _flatten_form_errors(form) -> list[str]:
        return [str(err) for errors in form.errors.values() for err in errors]


    class StaffTransitionView(StaffRequiredMixin, View):
        http_method_names = ["post"]

        def post(self, request: HttpRequest, *args, **kwargs) -> HttpResponse:
            petition = get_object_or_404(
                petitions_visible_to(request.user), public_id=kwargs["public_id"]
            )
            form = TransitionForm(request.POST)
            if not form.is_valid():
                messages.error(request, " ".join(_flatten_form_errors(form)))
                return redirect("petitions:staff_detail", public_id=petition.public_id)
            try:
                new = change_status(
                    petition,
                    request.user,
                    form.cleaned_data["expected_status"],
                    form.cleaned_data["new_status"],
                    form.cleaned_data["comment"],
                )
            except ValidationError as exc:
                messages.error(request, " ".join(exc.messages))
                return redirect("petitions:staff_detail", public_id=petition.public_id)
            messages.success(request, f"Статус изменён: {dict(PetitionStatus.choices)[new.status]}.")
            return redirect("petitions:staff_detail", public_id=petition.public_id)

  """TASK-017: "Справка в военкомат" becomes "Справка о поступлении" (rename in place)."""

  from django.db import migrations

  OLD = {
      "name": "Справка в военкомат",
      "comment_required": True,
      "comment_hint": "Укажите военкомат.",
      "description": "Справка для военного комиссариата.",
  }
  NEW = {
      "name": "Справка о поступлении",
      "comment_required": False,
      "comment_hint": "Можно указать, куда нужна справка.",
      "description": "Подтверждает зачисление в университет.",
  }


  def _rename(apps, source: dict, target: dict) -> None:
      RequestType = apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")
      row = RequestType.objects.filter(name=source["name"]).first()
      if row is None:
          return
      if RequestType.objects.filter(name=target["name"]).exists():
          # The target name is taken (created by hand): hide the source type instead.
          row.is_active = False
          row.save(update_fields=["is_active"])
          return
      for field, value in target.items():
          setattr(row, field, value)
      row.kind = "certificate"
      row.processing_days = 3
      row.subject_required = False
      row.save()


  def forwards(apps, schema_editor):
      _rename(apps, OLD, NEW)


  def backwards(apps, schema_editor):
      _rename(apps, NEW, OLD)


  class Migration(migrations.Migration):
      dependencies = [("petitions", "0004_documents_wording")]

      operations = [migrations.RunPython(forwards, backwards)]

  {% block extra_head %}<script src="{% static 'js/password-toggle.js' %}" defer></script>{% endblock %}
  {% block content %}
    <h1>Вход</h1>
    <form method="post" class="form">
      {% csrf_token %}
      {{ form.non_field_errors }}
      <div>{{ form.username.as_field_group }}</div>
      <div>
        {{ form.password.label_tag }}
        {{ form.password.errors }}
        <div class="password-field">
          {{ form.password }}
          <button type="button" class="password-toggle" data-password-toggle aria-controls="{{ form.password.id_for_label }}" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Показать пароль" hidden>{% include "includes/icon_eye.html" %}{% include "includes/icon_eye_off.html" %}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <input type="hidden" name="next" value="{{ next }}">
      <button type="submit">Войти</button>
    </form>
  {% endblock %}

  cat > static/js/password-toggle.js <<'EOF'
  /* Show/hide password on the login page (TASK-017). Progressive enhancement:
     without this script the toggle stays hidden and the form works as before. */
  (function () {
    "use strict";
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll("[data-password-toggle]");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(buttons, function (button) {
      var input = document.getElementById(button.getAttribute("aria-controls"));
      if (!input) {
        return;
      }
      function setShown(shown) {
        input.type = shown ? "text" : "password";
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", shown ? "true" : "false");
      }
      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setShown(input.type === "password");
      });
      if (input.form) {
        // Submit as a password field so browsers and password managers treat it as one.
        input.form.addEventListener("submit", function () {
          setShown(false);
        });
      }
      button.hidden = false;
    });
  })();
  EOF
  cat >> static/css/base.css <<'EOF'

  /* Password field with the show/hide toggle (TASK-017). */
  .password-field {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--space-2);
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .password-field input {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
  }

  .password-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-width: 2.75rem;
    min-height: 2.75rem;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .password-toggle[hidden] {
    display: none;
  }

  .password-toggle .icon-eye-off,
  .password-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .icon-eye {
    display: none;
  }

  .password-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] .icon-eye-off {
    display: block;
  }
  EOF

TransactionTestCase BEFORE = [("petitions", "0004_documents_wording")] AFTER = [("petitions", "0005_admission_certificate")] class AdmissionCertificateMigrationTests(TransactionTestCase):     def executor.loader.project_state(target).apps     def tearDown(self):         executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)         executor.loader.build_graph() RequestType.objects.create(**values)     def test_rename_in_place(self):         old_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)         old = self._make_old(old_apps)         new_apps = self._migrate(AFTER)         RequestType = new_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")         row = RequestType.objects.get(pk=old.pk)         self.assertEqual(row.name, "Справка о поступлении")         self.assertFalse(row.comment_required)         self.assertEqual(row.comment_hint, "Можно указать, куда нужна справка.")         self.assertEqual(row.description, "Подтверждает зачисление в self.assertFalse(RequestType.objects.filter(name="Справка в военкомат").exists())     def test_backwards(self):         old_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)         old = self._make_old(old_apps)         self._migrate(AFTER)         back_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)         row = back_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType").objects.get(pk=old.pk)         self.assertEqual(row.name, "Справка в военкомат")         self.assertTrue(row.comment_required)     def test_new_name_taken_hides_old(self):         old_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)         old = self._make_old(old_apps)         self._make_old(             old_apps, name="Справка о поступлении", comment_required=False, comment_hint=""         )         new_apps = self._migrate(AFTER)         RequestType = new_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")         self.assertFalse(RequestType.objects.get(pk=old.pk).is_active)         self.assertEqual(RequestType.objects.filter(name="Справка о   """TASK-017: "Документы" wording that agrees with the kind of a document."""

  import ast
  import re
  from pathlib import Path

  from django.apps import apps
  from django.conf import settings
  from django.test import SimpleTestCase, TestCase
  from django.urls import reverse

  from accounts.tests.helpers import make_faculty, make_group, make_staff, make_student
  from core.testing import FrozenClockMixin
  from petitions import wording
  from petitions.models import (
      Petition,
      PetitionAttachment,
      PetitionComment,
      PetitionStatus,
      PetitionStatusChange,
      RequestType,
  )
  from petitions.services import change_status, submit_petition
  from petitions.tests.helpers import make_petition, make_type

  OLD_WORD = re.compile(r"[Зз]аявк|[Зз]аявок")
  BASE = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
  APPS = (
      "accounts",
      "academics",
      "campusmap",
      "chat",
      "core",
      "notifications",
      "petitions",
      "schedule",
      "university",
  )


  class WordingUnitTests(SimpleTestCase):
      def test_generic_status_labels_masculine(self):
          self.assertEqual(
              dict(PetitionStatus.choices),
              {
                  "submitted": "Подан",
                  "in_progress": "В работе",
                  "ready": "Готов",
                  "issued": "Выдан",
                  "rejected": "Отклонён",
              },
          )

      def test_status_label_by_kind(self):
          cases = {
              "certificate": ["Подана", "В работе", "Готова", "Выдана", "Отклонена"],
              "application": ["Подано", "В работе", "Готово", "Выдано", "Отклонено"],
          }
          statuses = ["submitted", "in_progress", "ready", "issued", "rejected"]
          for kind, labels in cases.items():
              for status, label in zip(statuses, labels, strict=True):
                  self.assertEqual(wording.status_label(status, kind), label, (kind, status))

      def test_status_label_unknown_kind_is_generic(self):
          self.assertEqual(wording.status_label("ready", "other"), "Готов")

      def test_action_labels(self):
          self.assertEqual(wording.action_label("ready", "certificate"), "Отметить готовой")
          self.assertEqual(wording.action_label("issued", "certificate"), "Отметить выданной")
          self.assertEqual(wording.action_label("ready", "application"), "Отметить готовым")
          self.assertEqual(wording.action_label("issued", "application"), "Отметить выданным")
          self.assertEqual(wording.action_label("in_progress", "application"), "Взять в работу")
          self.assertEqual(wording.action_label("rejected", "application"), "Отклонить")

      def test_plural(self):
          forms = wording.DOCUMENT_FORMS
          expected = {
              1: "документ",
              2: "документа",
              3: "документа",
              4: "документа",
              5: "документов",
              11: "документов",
              12: "документов",
              14: "документов",
              21: "документ",
              22: "документа",
              25: "документов",
              111: "документов",
          }
          for n, form in expected.items():
              self.assertEqual(wording.plural_ru(n, forms), form, n)

      def test_notification_titles(self):
          cert = {
              "in_progress": "«Х» взята в работу",
              "ready": "«Х» готова — заберите её в деканате",
              "issued": "«Х» выдана",
              "rejected": "«Х» отклонена",
              "submitted": "«Х»: статус «Подана»",
          }
          appl = {
              "in_progress": "«Х» взято в работу",
              "ready": "«Х» готово — заберите его в деканате",
              "issued": "«Х» выдано",
              "rejected": "«Х» отклонено",
              "submitted": "«Х»: статус «Подано»",
          }
          for status, title in cert.items():
              self.assertEqual(wording.notification_title(status, "certificate", "Х"), title)
          for status, title in appl.items():
              self.assertEqual(wording.notification_title(status, "application", "Х"), title)

      def test_admin_names(self):
          self.assertEqual(apps.get_app_config("petitions").verbose_name, "Документы")
          self.assertEqual(Petition._meta.verbose_name, "документ")
          self.assertEqual(Petition._meta.verbose_name_plural, "документы")
          self.assertEqual(RequestType._meta.verbose_name, "вид документа")
          self.assertEqual(RequestType._meta.verbose_name_plural, "виды документов")
          self.assertEqual(PetitionAttachment._meta.verbose_name, "файл к документу")
          self.assertEqual(PetitionAttachment._meta.verbose_name_plural, "файлы к документам")
          for model in (PetitionAttachment, PetitionStatusChange, PetitionComment):
              self.assertEqual(model._meta.get_field("petition").verbose_name, "документ")
          self.assertEqual(Petition._meta.get_field("request_type").verbose_name, "вид документа")


  class NoOldWordTests(SimpleTestCase):
      """No user-visible "заявка" is left; "заявление" (a kind) stays."""

      def test_templates(self):
          paths = sorted(BASE.glob("templates/**/*.html")) + sorted(
              BASE.glob("*/templates/**/*.html")
          )
          self.assertGreater(len(paths), 30)
          for path in paths:
              self.assertIsNone(OLD_WORD.search(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), path)

      def test_python_strings(self):
          checked = 0
          for app in APPS:
              for path in sorted((BASE / app).rglob("*.py")):
                  if "tests" in path.parts or "migrations" in path.parts:
                      continue
                  tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                  for node in ast.walk(tree):
                      if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
                          checked += 1
                          self.assertIsNone(OLD_WORD.search(node.value), f"{path}: {node.value}")
          self.assertGreater(checked, 500)

      def test_static_js(self):
          for path in sorted((BASE / "static" / "js").glob("*.js")):
              self.assertIsNone(OLD_WORD.search(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), path)


  class PagesWordingTests(FrozenClockMixin, TestCase):
      def setUp(self):
          self.fac = make_faculty("FX")
          self.group = make_group(self.fac, "GX")
          self.student = make_student("a", self.group, "SA").student_profile
          self.staff = make_staff("sx", self.fac)
          self.cert = make_type(name="Справка Х")
          self.appl = make_type(name="Заявление Х", kind="application", days=5)
          self.p_cert = make_petition(self.student, self.cert)
          self.p_appl = make_petition(self.student, self.appl)

      def _student_get(self, url):
          self.client.force_login(self.student.user)
          response = self.client.get(url)
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, url)
          return response.content.decode()

      def _staff_get(self, url):
          self.client.force_login(self.staff)
          response = self.client.get(url)
          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, url)
          return response.content.decode()

      def test_nav_and_titles(self):
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:my_list"))
          self.assertIn('aria-current="page">Документы</a>', content)
          self.assertIn("<h1>Мои документы</h1>", content)
          self.assertIn(">Оформить документ</a>", content)
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:catalog"))
          self.assertIn("<h1>Оформить документ</h1>", content)
          content = self._staff_get(reverse("petitions:staff_queue"))
          self.assertIn('aria-current="page">Документы</a>', content)
          self.assertIn("<h1>Документы</h1>", content)
          self.assertIn('<label for="type">Вид документа</label>', content)

      def test_submit_buttons_by_kind(self):
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:submit", args=[self.cert.pk]))
          self.assertIn('<button type="submit">Заказать справку</button>', content)
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:submit", args=[self.appl.pk]))
          self.assertIn('<button type="submit">Подать заявление</button>', content)

      def test_submitted_page_by_kind(self):
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:submitted", args=[self.p_cert.public_id]))
          self.assertIn("<h1>Справка заказана</h1>", content)
          self.assertIn(">К справке</a>", content)
          self.assertIn(">Мои документы</a>", content)
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:submitted", args=[self.p_appl.public_id]))
          self.assertIn("<h1>Заявление подано</h1>", content)
          self.assertIn(">К заявлению</a>", content)

      def test_student_list_and_detail_status_by_kind(self):
          change_status(self.p_appl, self.staff, "submitted", "in_progress")
          change_status(self.p_appl, self.staff, "in_progress", "ready")
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:my_list"))
          self.assertIn('status--submitted">Подана</span>', content)
          self.assertIn('status--ready">Готово</span>', content)
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:detail", args=[self.p_appl.public_id]))
          self.assertIn('<p class="status status--ready">Готово</p>', content)
          self.assertIn("<p>Подано: ", content)
          self.assertIn("Подано → В работе", content)
          self.assertIn("В работе → Готово", content)
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:detail", args=[self.p_cert.public_id]))
          self.assertIn("<p>Подана: ", content)

      def test_staff_pages_by_kind(self):
          content = self._staff_get(reverse("petitions:staff_queue"))
          self.assertIn('<option value="submitted" selected>Подан</option>', content.replace(
              '<option value="submitted">', '<option value="submitted" selected>'
          ))
          self.assertIn('status--submitted">Подано</span>', content)
          self.assertIn('status--submitted">Подана</span>', content)
          content = self._staff_get(reverse("petitions:staff_detail", args=[self.p_cert.public_id]))
          self.assertIn(f"<h1>Справка № {self.p_cert.short_id}</h1>", content)
          self.assertIn("<h2>Документ</h2>", content)
          change_status(self.p_appl, self.staff, "submitted", "in_progress")
          content = self._staff_get(reverse("petitions:staff_detail", args=[self.p_appl.public_id]))
          self.assertIn(f"<h1>Заявление № {self.p_appl.short_id}</h1>", content)
          self.assertIn(">Отметить готовым</button>", content)
          change_status(self.p_cert, self.staff, "submitted", "in_progress")
          content = self._staff_get(reverse("petitions:staff_detail", args=[self.p_cert.public_id]))
          self.assertIn(">Отметить готовой</button>", content)

      def test_flash_message_by_kind(self):
          self.client.force_login(self.staff)
          response = self.client.post(
              reverse("petitions:staff_transition", args=[self.p_appl.public_id]),
              {"expected_status": "submitted", "new_status": "in_progress"},
              follow=True,
          )
          self.assertIn("Статус изменён: В работе.", response.content.decode())
          response = self.client.post(
              reverse("petitions:staff_transition", args=[self.p_appl.public_id]),
              {"expected_status": "in_progress", "new_status": "ready"},
              follow=True,
          )
          self.assertIn("Статус изменён: Готово.", response.content.decode())

      def test_comment_required_error_by_kind(self):
          cert = make_type(name="Справка К", comment_required=True, hint="Причина")
          appl = make_type(name="Заявление К", kind="application", comment_required=True, hint="П")
          self.client.force_login(self.student.user)
          response = self.client.post(reverse("petitions:submit", args=[cert.pk]), {"comment": ""})
          self.assertIn("Для этой справки комментарий обязателен.", response.content.decode())
          response = self.client.post(reverse("petitions:submit", args=[appl.pk]), {"comment": ""})
          self.assertIn("Для этого заявления комментарий обязателен.", response.content.decode())
          with self.assertRaises(Exception) as cm:
              submit_petition(self.student, appl, "", [])
          self.assertIn("Для этого заявления комментарий обязателен.", cm.exception.messages)

      def test_subject_hint_by_kind(self):
          cert = make_type(name="Другая С", comment_required=True, hint="h", subject_required=True)
          appl = make_type(
              name="Другое З", kind="application", comment_required=True, hint="h",
              subject_required=True,
          )
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:submit", args=[cert.pk]))
          self.assertIn("Что именно нужно, например: «Справка о периоде обучения».", content)
          content = self._student_get(reverse("petitions:submit", args=[appl.pk]))
          self.assertIn(
              "Что именно нужно, например: «Заявление на индивидуальный учебный план».", content
          )
          self.assertNotIn("Справка о периоде обучения", content)

      def test_notifications_by_kind(self):
          change_status(self.p_cert, self.staff, "submitted", "in_progress")
          change_status(self.p_appl, self.staff, "submitted", "in_progress")
          change_status(self.p_appl, self.staff, "in_progress", "ready")
          content = self._student_get(reverse("notifications:feed"))
          self.assertIn("«Справка Х» взята в работу", content)
          self.assertIn("«Заявление Х» взято в работу", content)
          self.assertIn("«Заявление Х» готово — заберите его в деканате", content)
          self.assertIn("Документы&nbsp;·", content)

  """TASK-017: data migration 0005 renames "Справка в военкомат" in place."""

  from django.db import connection
  from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
  from django.test import TransactionTestCase

  BEFORE = [("petitions", "0004_documents_wording")]
  AFTER = [("petitions", "0005_admission_certificate")]


  class AdmissionCertificateMigrationTests(TransactionTestCase):
      def _migrate(self, target):
          executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
          executor.loader.build_graph()
          executor.migrate(target)
          return executor.loader.project_state(target).apps

      def tearDown(self):
          executor = MigrationExecutor(connection)
          executor.loader.build_graph()
          executor.migrate(executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes())

      def _make_old(self, apps, **extra):
          RequestType = apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")
          values = {
              "name": "Справка в военкомат",
              "kind": "certificate",
              "processing_days": 3,
              "comment_required": True,
              "comment_hint": "Укажите военкомат.",
              "description": "Справка для военного комиссариата.",
              "subject_required": False,
              "is_active": True,
          }
          values.update(extra)
          return RequestType.objects.create(**values)

      def test_rename_in_place(self):
          old_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)
          old = self._make_old(old_apps)
          new_apps = self._migrate(AFTER)
          RequestType = new_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")
          row = RequestType.objects.get(pk=old.pk)
          self.assertEqual(row.name, "Справка о поступлении")
          self.assertFalse(row.comment_required)
          self.assertEqual(row.comment_hint, "Можно указать, куда нужна справка.")
          self.assertEqual(row.description, "Подтверждает зачисление в университет.")
          self.assertEqual(row.processing_days, 3)
          self.assertEqual(row.kind, "certificate")
          self.assertTrue(row.is_active)
          self.assertFalse(RequestType.objects.filter(name="Справка в военкомат").exists())

      def test_backwards(self):
          old_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)
          old = self._make_old(old_apps)
          self._migrate(AFTER)
          back_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)
          row = back_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType").objects.get(pk=old.pk)
          self.assertEqual(row.name, "Справка в военкомат")
          self.assertTrue(row.comment_required)

      def test_new_name_taken_hides_old(self):
          old_apps = self._migrate(BEFORE)
          old = self._make_old(old_apps)
          self._make_old(
              old_apps, name="Справка о поступлении", comment_required=False, comment_hint=""
          )
          new_apps = self._migrate(AFTER)
          RequestType = new_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")
          self.assertFalse(RequestType.objects.get(pk=old.pk).is_active)
          self.assertEqual(RequestType.objects.filter(name="Справка о поступлении").count(), 1)

      def test_no_old_type_is_noop(self):
          self._migrate(BEFORE)
          new_apps = self._migrate(AFTER)
          RequestType = new_apps.get_model("petitions", "RequestType")
          self.assertFalse(RequestType.objects.filter(name__startswith="Справка").exists())

  """TASK-017: show/hide password toggle on the login page."""

  import re
  from pathlib import Path

  from django.conf import settings
  from django.test import SimpleTestCase, TestCase
  from django.urls import reverse

  BASE = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)


  class LoginToggleMarkupTests(TestCase):
      def _content(self, **post):
          if post:
              return self.client.post(reverse("accounts:login"), post).content.decode()
          return self.client.get(reverse("accounts:login")).content.decode()

      def _button(self, content):
          match = re.search(r"<button [^>]*data-password-toggle[^>]*>", content)
          self.assertIsNotNone(match)
          return match.group(0)

      def test_toggle_button_attributes(self):
          button = self._button(self._content())
          for attr in (
              'type="button"',
              'class="password-toggle"',
              'aria-controls="id_password"',
              'aria-pressed="false"',
              'aria-label="Показать пароль"',
              " hidden",
          ):
              self.assertIn(attr, button)

      def test_two_pixel_icons(self):
          content = self._content()
          start = content.index("data-password-toggle")
          end = content.index("</button>", start)
          inner = content[start:end]
          self.assertEqual(inner.count("<svg"), 2)
          self.assertIn('class="icon-eye"', inner)
          self.assertIn('class="icon-eye-off"', inner)
          self.assertEqual(inner.count('shape-rendering="crispEdges"'), 2)
          self.assertEqual(inner.count('aria-hidden="true"'), 2)
          self.assertEqual(inner.count('focusable="false"'), 2)
          self.assertNotIn("<path", inner)

      def test_script_external_and_deferred(self):
          content = self._content()
          self.assertIn('<script src="/static/js/password-toggle.js" defer></script>', content)
          self.assertNotIn("<script>", content)

      def test_fields_keep_autocomplete(self):
          content = self._content()
          self.assertRegex(content, r'<input type="text" name="username"[^>]*autocomplete="username"')
          self.assertRegex(
              content, r'<input type="password" name="password"[^>]*autocomplete="current-password"'
          )
          self.assertEqual(content.count('name="password"'), 1)
          self.assertIn('<label for="id_password">', content)
          self.assertIn('<label for="id_username">', content)

      def test_errors_still_shown(self):
          content = self._content(username="nobody", password="")
          self.assertIn('id="id_password_error"', content)
          self.assertIn('aria-describedby="id_password_error"', content)
          content = self._content(username="nobody", password="wrong")
          self.assertIn('class="errorlist nonfield"', content)
          self.assertIn('data-password-toggle', content)


  class LoginToggleStaticTests(SimpleTestCase):
      def test_script(self):
          js = (BASE / "static/js/password-toggle.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          for fragment in (
              "[data-password-toggle]",
              'getAttribute("aria-controls")',
              'setAttribute("aria-pressed"',
              '"text" : "password"',
              '"submit"',
              "button.hidden = false",
          ):
              self.assertIn(fragment, js)
          for forbidden in ("innerHTML", "eval(", "aria-label", "fetch(", "localStorage"):
              self.assertNotIn(forbidden, js)

      def test_css(self):
          base = (BASE / "static/css/base.css").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          self.assertRegex(base, r"\.password-toggle\[hidden\]\s*\{\s*display:\s*none;")
          self.assertRegex(base, r"\.password-toggle\s*\{[^}]*min-width:\s*2\.75rem")
          self.assertRegex(base, r"\.password-toggle\s*\{[^}]*min-height:\s*2\.75rem")
          self.assertRegex(
              base, r'\.password-toggle\[aria-pressed="true"\]\s*\.icon-eye-off\s*\{\s*display:\s*block'
          )

      def test_icons(self):
          for name in ("icon_eye.html", "icon_eye_off.html"):
              svg = (BASE / "templates/includes" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
              self.assertIn('shape-rendering="crispEdges"', svg)
              self.assertIn('fill="currentColor"', svg)
              self.assertIn("<rect", svg)
              for forbidden in ("style=", "<path", "<script", "href="):
                  self.assertNotIn(forbidden, svg)

    +# TASK-017: password toggle; "Заявки" → "Документы"; "Справка о поступлении"; "Тип" hint by kind
    +
    +Author: Planner. Assignee: UI coder. Status: ready for implementation.
    +Base: HEAD 16399ea (TASK-016 committed; clean tree except the Team lead's `plan.md`; do not touch it).
    +
    +## 1. Goal
    +
    +Four small user-requested changes (user decisions 20.11, `plan.md`).
    +
    +### Acceptance criteria
    +
    +| ID | Criterion |
    +|---|---|
    +| AC1 | Login page: a show/hide password button next to the password field. Our own pixel eye icon (inline SVG of `<rect>`, `shape-rendering="crispEdges"`, `fill="currentColor"`), two states: open eye (password hidden) and crossed eye (password shown). Tap target ≥ 44 × 44 px. Visible focus (the project focus outline). `type="button"`, `aria-controls="id_password"`, `aria-pressed` true/false, Russian accessible name. Text/icon contrast WCAG AA (tokens only). |
    +| AC2 | The button is in the markup with `hidden`; only `static/js/password-toggle.js` (external, `defer`) shows it and switches the input type. Without JavaScript the button stays hidden and the form works as now. The CSP of TASK-016 allows it unchanged. On submit the field is switched back to `type="password"`. `autocomplete="username"` / `"current-password"`, field names, labels and error markup stay. |
    +| AC3 | No user-visible "заявка" in any form remains (templates, Python strings of the apps, JS): nav, home, page titles, buttons, messages, form errors, notifications, demo chat text, admin names. Where the kind is known: "справка" (feminine) / "заявление" (neuter) with correct agreement; where kinds are mixed: "документ"/"документы" (masculine). "Заявление/Заявления" as a kind stays. URLs, URL names, Python names, model and app labels stay. |
    +| AC4 | Status labels agree with the noun: on pages about one document — feminine for a certificate (Подана, Готова, Выдана, Отклонена), neuter for an application (Подано, Готово, Выдано, Отклонено); in mixed lists of one kind per row the row's kind; in mixed filters/admin — masculine ("документ": Подан, Готов, Выдан, Отклонён). "В работе" is the same for all. Staff action buttons agree too ("Отметить готовой/выданной" vs "Отметить готовым/выданным"). |
    +| AC5 | "Справка в военкомат" becomes "Справка о поступлении" (certificate, comment optional, hint "Можно указать, куда нужна справка.", 3 working days, description "Подтверждает зачисление в университет.") by renaming the row in place (data migration 0005). After the migration on a database seeded before, there is exactly one of the two names; a fresh database after `seed_demo` has only the new type; `seed_demo` twice changes nothing. |
    +| AC6 | The "Тип" hint: certificate kinds «Справка о периоде обучения» (as now), application kinds «Заявление на индивидуальный учебный план». |
    +| AC7 | Tests (section 7) and all verification commands pass; visual check (section 8) done and reported with screenshots. |
    +
    +## 2. Out of scope
    +
    +- URLs (`/requests/…`, `/staff/requests/…`), URL names, Python/model/app identifiers, the `RequestKind` labels ("Справка", "Заявление"), type names other than the renamed one.
    +- The empty required comment still shows Django's "Обязательное поле." (TASK-014-FIX decision).
    +- Existing chat demo rows keep the old text (`seed_demo` never updates rows; accepted by the Team lead).
    +- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `plan.md`, `docs/`. The admin login page (no toggle there).
    +
    +## 3. Design decisions
    +
    +- **D1. One wording module.** `petitions/wording.py` holds every kind-dependent text (status labels, action
    +  labels, page texts, notification titles, plural helper). Templates use two filters from
    +  `petitions/templatetags/petition_wording.py`: `status_for` and `kind_text`. Every text is in one place and is
    +  tested in one test module.
    +- **D2. Status labels by kind (beyond the request map, same rule "adapt grammar").** Today the labels
    +  "Подана/Готова/Выдана/Отклонена" agree with "заявка". After the rename they would be wrong for applications
    +  ("Заявление … Готова") and in mixed places ("Документы: Подана"). So: `PetitionStatus` labels become masculine
    +  (they appear only where kinds are mixed: staff status filter, admin, the "Нельзя перевести документ из «…»"
    +  error); every place about one document uses `status_label(status, kind)`. The date line "Подана: …" on both
    +  detail pages becomes the kind's "submitted" label ("Подана:" / "Подано:"). The Team lead is informed.
    +- **D3. Rename in place, not deactivate** (AC5). A deactivated old type would stay in the staff type filter
    +  (`RequestType.objects.all()`) next to the new one, and `seed_demo` upserts by name, so a renamed row is found
    +  by its new name and nothing is duplicated. Existing petitions of that type (trial database only; the final
    +  database is created on 22.11 after this task) then show the new name — acceptable for a demo. If a row with the
    +  new name already exists (only if created by hand), the old row is deactivated instead. The migration is
    +  reversible.
    +- **D4. Toggle accessible name stays "Показать пароль"; the state is `aria-pressed`.** The request lists both
    +  "Показать пароль" / "Скрыть пароль" and `aria-pressed`. A toggle button must not change its name when the
    +  state changes (WAI-ARIA APG, Button pattern): screen readers would announce "Скрыть пароль, нажата" — a double
    +  negation. With a fixed name: "Показать пароль, кнопка-переключатель, нажата" = the password is shown. Sighted
    +  users see the state by the icon (open vs crossed eye). The Team lead is informed.
    +- **D5. The toggle is a panel button**, not the orange primary: `.form button` styles every button in the form,
    +  so `.form .password-toggle` (higher specificity) restores the panel look (`--color-panel`, frame). It sits in a
    +  flex row right of the input (`.password-field`), so the input keeps its full height and the toggle is a 44 px
    +  square-ish target. `.password-toggle[hidden] { display: none; }` is required because `display: inline-flex`
    +  would otherwise override the `hidden` attribute.
    +- **D6. Icons:** `templates/includes/icon_eye.html` and `icon_eye_off.html`, viewBox 12 × 8, `<rect>` only,
    +  like `icon_bell.html`. The reference drawings below passed the tests and work in Chrome; you may redraw them
    +  for readability (keep: rects only, crispEdges, currentColor, aria-hidden, focusable="false", 12 × 8 grid or a
    +  multiple, rendered at least 24 × 16 CSS px).
    +- **D7. "У вас уже N документа этого вида в работе."** N is `MAX_OPEN_PER_TYPE` (3); the noun comes from
    +  `plural_ru(n, ("документ", "документа", "документов"))`, so a future limit stays correct.
    +- **D8. The comment-required message by kind** is used by `submit_petition` and `PetitionForm.clean_comment`.
    +  In the form an empty comment is caught first by Django's required check, so the message is visible through the
    +  service path (tests use the service).
    +- **D9. Notifications:** the type name is the subject ("«Справка об обучении» взята в работу"); tag
    +  "Документы"; the comment title "Комментарий деканата: «{name}»". `PetitionStatusSource.related` already
    +  selects `petition__request_type`, so no extra queries.
    +- **D10. Queries:** templates read `petition.request_type.kind`; every view that lists or shows petitions
    +  already loads `request_type` (`select_related` in `petitions_visible_to`/views; the existing `QueryCountTests`
    +  pass unchanged). History rows use the parent `petition`, not `change.petition`.

  import sys
  W, H = 18, 12
  def cells_from(rows):
      s=set()
      for y,row in enumerate(rows):
          for x,ch in enumerate(row):
              if ch=="#": s.add((x,y))
      return s
  EYE = [
   "..................",
   ".......####.......",
   ".....##....##.....",
   "...##..####..##...",
   "..#...#.####..#...",
   "##....######....##",
   "##....######....##",
   "..#...######..#...",
   "...##..####..##...",
   ".....##....##.....",
   ".......####.......",
   "..................",
  ]
  eye = cells_from(EYE)
  # slash for the "shown" state: top-left to bottom-right, 2 cells wide, with a 1-cell gap
  slash=set(); gap=set()
  for y in range(H):
      x = round(1 + y * 15 / 11)
      slash |= {(x, y), (x + 1, y)}
      gap |= {(x - 1, y), (x + 2, y)}
  off = (eye - gap - slash) | slash
  def rects(cells):
      out=[]
      for y in range(H):
          xs=sorted(x for x,yy in cells if yy==y)
          i=0
          while i<len(xs):
              j=i
              while j+1<len(xs) and xs[j+1]==xs[j]+1: j+=1
              out.append(f'<rect x="{xs[i]}" y="{y}" width="{xs[j]-xs[i]+1}" height="1"/>')
              i=j+1
      return "".join(out)
  def svg(cls, cells):
      return (f'<svg class="{cls}" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" width="36" height="24" shape-rendering="crispEdges" '
              f'aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><g fill="currentColor">{rects(cells)}</g></svg>')
  open(sys.argv[1]+"/icon_eye.html","w").write(svg("icon-eye", eye)+"\n")
  open(sys.argv[1]+"/icon_eye_off.html","w").write(svg("icon-eye-off", off)+"\n")
  for name,c in (("eye",eye),("off",off)):
      print(name)
      for y in range(H): print("".join("#" if (x,y) in c else "." for x in range(W)))

              j=i
              while j+1<len(xs) and xs[j+1]==xs[j]+1: j+=1
              out.append(f'<rect x="{xs[i]}" y="{y}" width="{xs[j]-xs[i]+1}" height="1"/>'); i=j+1
      return "".join(out)
  def svg(cls,c,w=36,h=24): return f'<svg class="{cls}" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" width="{w}" height="{h}" shape-rendering="crispEdges" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><g fill="currentColor">{rects(c)}</g></svg>'
  EYE_A = [
   "..................",
   "......######......",

   "..##....##....##..",

  import pathlib
  p=pathlib.Path("accounts/tests/test_login_page.py"); t=p.read_text()
  t=t.rstrip("\n")+'''


  class EyeIconDrawingTests(SimpleTestCase):
      """TASK-016-FIX: an almond eye with a round pupil; the "shown" state is crossed out."""

      @staticmethod
      def _cells(name):
          svg = (BASE / "templates/includes" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          cells = set()
          for x, y, w, h in re.findall(
              r'<rect x="(\\d+)" y="(\\d+)" width="(\\d+)" height="(\\d+)"/>', svg
          ):
              for dx in range(int(w)):
                  for dy in range(int(h)):
                      cells.add((int(x) + dx, int(y) + dy))
          return cells

      def test_open_eye_shape(self):
          cells = self._cells("icon_eye.html")
          # Pointed corners: the outermost columns hold only the two middle rows.
          self.assertEqual({y for x, y in cells if x == 0}, {5, 6})
          self.assertEqual({y for x, y in cells if x == 17}, {5, 6})
          # Symmetric lids: the outline is mirrored left/right.
          outline = {(x, y) for x, y in cells if x < 6 or x > 11 or y in (1, 10)}
          self.assertEqual(outline, {(17 - x, y) for x, y in outline})
          # Round pupil: 4 wide at the top and bottom rows, 6 wide in the middle, a highlight gap.
          pupil = {(x, y) for x, y in cells if 6 <= x <= 11 and 3 <= y <= 8}
          self.assertEqual({x for x, y in pupil if y == 3}, {7, 8, 9, 10})
          self.assertEqual({x for x, y in pupil if y == 8}, {7, 8, 9, 10})
          self.assertEqual({x for x, y in pupil if y in (6, 7)}, set(range(6, 12)))
          self.assertLess(len(pupil), 32)  # not a filled square: the highlight is empty

      def test_crossed_eye_has_diagonal(self):
          cells = self._cells("icon_eye_off.html")
          for y in range(12):
              self.assertIn((3 + y, y), cells, y)
              self.assertIn((4 + y, y), cells, y)
              self.assertNotIn((2 + y, y), cells, y)
              self.assertNotIn((5 + y, y), cells, y)
          # The same pointed corners as the open eye.
          self.assertEqual({y for x, y in cells if x == 0}, {5, 6})
          self.assertEqual({y for x, y in cells if x == 17}, {5, 6})
  '''

      def test_csrf_failure_uses_project_template(self):

          self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)

          self.assertNotIn("<style", content)
          self.assertNotIn("CSRF", content)

          for forbidden in ("<style", "style=", "<script", " on"):
              self.assertNotIn(forbidden, text)

    +# TASK-016-FIX: systemd paths optional, themed CSRF page, readable eye icon, submit-reset test
    +
    +Author: Planner. Assignee: UI coder. Status: ready for implementation.
    +Base: HEAD 30eab5c (TASK-017 committed; clean tree except the Team lead's `plan.md`; do not touch it).
    +
    +## 1. Goal
    +
    +Non-blocking notes from the TASK-016/TASK-017 reviews and the Team lead's browser check (21.11).
    +
    +### Acceptance criteria
    +
    +| ID | Criterion |
    +|---|---|
    +| AC1 | `deploy/systemd/deanery.service`: `ReadWritePaths=-/srv/deanery/private_media -/srv/deanery/private_media_trial` (both prefixed with `-`, systemd then skips a missing path instead of failing the namespace setup), with a one-line comment. The deploy test checks the new line. |
    +| AC2 | A CSRF failure renders the themed page `templates/403_csrf.html` (extends `base.html`, like `403.html`): h1 "Форма устарела", Russian text (the form is out of date; go back, reload, send again), a "На главную" button. No inline style/script/handlers. Status 403, CSP header present, no CSP violation in the browser. |
    +| AC3 | The eye icons are redrawn: an almond eye with pointed corners, a round pupil with a highlight pixel (state "password hidden"); the same almond outline with a clear diagonal slash (state "password shown"). Same size (36 × 24 CSS px), same classes, `<rect>` only, `crispEdges`, `currentColor`, `aria-hidden`, `focusable="false"`. Readable at 360 px with deviceScaleFactor 1 and 2. Tap target, toggle behaviour and all TASK-017 tests unchanged. |
    +| AC4 | A static test proves the submit handler of `static/js/password-toggle.js` calls exactly `setShown(false)` and `setShown` sets `type` by `shown ? "text" : "password"`. The script itself is not changed. |
    +| AC5 | All verification commands pass; visual check reported (section 8). |
    +
    +## 2. Out of scope
    +
    +IPv6 /128 keying of the nginx zones (accepted: no public IPv6). Any other page, script or deploy file. `docs/DEPLOY.md`
    +(it does not mention `ReadWritePaths`; the Team lead re-installs the unit with runbook step 21 commands).
    +
    +## 3. Design decisions
    +
    +- **D1. `-` prefix** (systemd.exec(5): "Paths in ReadWritePaths= … may be prefixed with "-", in which case they
    +  will be ignored when they do not exist"). With a missing `private_media` the app still starts and only uploads
    +  fail with a logged error — better than a unit that does not start; the Team lead accepted both prefixes.
    +- **D2. `403_csrf.html` is Django's own hook.** `django.views.csrf.csrf_failure` (Django 5.2) loads
    +  `CSRF_FAILURE_TEMPLATE_NAME = "403_csrf.html"` first and renders it with `request=request`, so context
    +  processors run and `base.html` works (nav, user, messages). Only when the template is missing does it use the
    +  built-in page with inline CSS. No setting or view is needed. The text does not say "CSRF" (users do not know
    +  the term).
    +- **D3. The new icon grid is 18 × 12 cells drawn at 36 × 24 px** (2 CSS px per cell; 4 device px at scale 2).
    +  12 × 8 cells (3 px) is too coarse for pointed corners and a round pupil. The drawings below were chosen from five
    +  variants in Chrome: a slash through the pupil (with or without gaps) turned into noise at real size; the
    +  crossed state therefore keeps the almond outline and drops the pupil, and the slash is 2 cells wide at 45°
    +  with a 1-cell gap on both sides, so it cuts the outline cleanly.
    +
    +  Open eye (`icon_eye.html`), `#` = filled cell:
    +
    +  ```
    +  ..................
    +  ......######......
    +  ....##......##....
    +  ..##...####...##..
    +  .#....##..##....#.
    +  #.....#.####.....#
    +  #.....######.....#
    +  .#....######....#.
    +  ..##...####...##..
    +  ....##......##....
    +  ......######......
    +  ..................
    +  ```
    +
    +  Crossed eye (`icon_eye_off.html`):
    +
    +  ```
    +  ...##.............
    +  ....##.#####......
    +  .....##.....##....
    +  ..##..##......##..
    +  .#.....##.......#.
    +  #.......##.......#
    +  #........##......#
    +  .#........##....#.
    +  ..##.......##.##..
    +  ....##......##....
    +  ......######.##...
    +  ..............##..
    +  ```
    +
    +  Each row's runs of `#` are one `<rect height="1">` (the files below are exactly that). You may adjust a few
    +  cells after your own look, but the drawing tests (F4) must stay green: pointed corners (only rows 5–6 in the
    +  first and last column), mirrored lids, round pupil (rows 3 and 8: 4 cells; rows 6–7: 6 cells; an empty
    +  highlight cell), and the slash cells `(3+y, y)`, `(4+y, y)` with empty `(2+y, y)`, `(5+y, y)` in every row.
    +- **D4. The submit-reset test parses the handler body** with a regular expression and requires it to be exactly
    +  `setShown(false);`. Mutation check: replacing it with `setShown(true);`, commenting it out, or setting
    +  `input.type = "text"` in `setShown` each makes the test fail.
    +

## Items
1. Stars on wide screens. User: on the desktop the stars look very strange - they sit only at the edges and form a "ladder". Cause (`static/css/theme.css:30-95`): `body::before` / `body::after` put all side stars into two 3-4 px wide columns at `left: 4px` / `right: 5px` with x offsets of 0-3 px, so on a wide screen they read as two vertical zig-zag lines at the window edges; the header stars are hidden from 48rem. Redraw the stars for wide screens: scattered irregularly over the whole free side margins on both sides (varied x and y, no visible rows, columns, diagonals or ladders), the same two colours and pixel style, still pure CSS, never over the content column, header or footer text or controls (D13 from TASK-012 stays). Choose the breakpoints from the real content width. Check 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 px (and that 360 px is unchanged or better). No JavaScript, no images, no inline styles (CSP).
2. Staff chat counter in the menu. Students see "Чат (n)" (`templates/includes/site_nav_items.html:8`, `chat/templatetags/chat_tags.py`, `chat/selectors.py::student_unread_count`). Staff see only "Чаты" (`site_nav_items.html:13`). Show "Чаты (n)" for staff, where n = unread student messages in the dialogs this staff member can see: the same rule as the "new" counts of the staff chat list (`chat/selectors.py::staff_dialog_list`: `author_role` student, `id > dialog.staff_read_id`, dialogs from `dialogs_visible_to`). Same cap and hiding as for students (`CHAT_BADGE_CAP`, "N+", nothing when 0); computed on page load like the student badge (no polling); one query, no N+1. The read marker is shared by the faculty's staff (shared inbox, decision 15.11): when one staff member opens a dialog, the count drops for all of them - keep that. The student badge stays unchanged; superusers and anonymous users get no badge.

## Verification

Item 1: a visual check with screenshots at the widths above (both pages with short and long content), and a test that the stars stay CSS-only (no new markup or inline style).

    from django import template

    from chat.constants import CHAT_BADGE_CAP
    from chat.selectors import student_unread_count

    register = template.Library()


    @register.simple_tag(takes_context=True)
    def chat_unread_badge(context) -> str:
        request = context.get("request")
        if request is None:
            return ""
        count = student_unread_count(request.user)
        if count == 0:
            return ""
        if count > CHAT_BADGE_CAP:
            return f"{CHAT_BADGE_CAP}+"
        return str(count)

  import random, math, itertools
  P=1600
  def gen(seed, n):
      r=random.Random(seed)
      pts=[]
      tries=0
      while len(pts)<n:
          tries+=1
          x=r.uniform(4,96); y=r.uniform(24,P-24)
          # distance in a 300px-wide band metric, wrap in y
          ok=True
          for (a,b) in pts:
              dy=min(abs(y-b),P-abs(y-b)); dx=(x-a)*3
              if math.hypot(dx,dy)<P/n*0.75: ok=False;break
          if ok: pts.append((x,y))
      return [(round(x),int(round(y/2)*2)) for x,y in pts]
  for side,seed in (("left",7),("right",11)):
      pts=sorted(gen(seed,14),key=lambda p:p[1])
      print(side,pts)

  import random
  P=1600
  def gen(seed,n):
      r=random.Random(seed); pts=[]
      h=P/n
      for i in range(n):
          y=int(i*h+r.uniform(0.15,0.85)*h)//2*2
          while True:
              x=r.randint(5,95)
              if all(abs(x-p[0])>=22 for p in pts[-2:]): 
                  # avoid 3 collinear-ish with last two
                  if len(pts)>=2:
                      (x1,y1),(x2,y2)=pts[-2],pts[-1]
                      # predicted x at y on line through last two
                      px=x2+(x2-x1)*(y-y2)/max(1,(y2-y1))
                      if abs(px-x)<12: continue
                  break
          pts.append((x,y))
      return pts
  for side,seed in (("left",3),("right",5)):
      pts=gen(seed,14)
      cols=random.Random(seed+1)
      c=[ "Y" if cols.random()<0.5 else "L" for _ in pts]
      print(side,[(x,y,k) for (x,y),k in zip(pts,c)])

    $ cat > "$TMPDIR/t018work/gen2.py" <<'EOF'
  import random, math, json
  P=1600; W=360  # metric: band width taken as 360 px
  def dist(a,b):
      dx=(a[0]-b[0])/100*W; dy=abs(a[1]-b[1]); dy=min(dy,P-dy)
      return math.hypot(dx,dy)
  def mitchell(seed,n,k=40):
      r=random.Random(seed); pts=[]
      for i in range(n):
          best=None;bd=-1
          for _ in range(k):
              c=(r.randint(4,96), r.randint(12,P//2-12)*2)
              d=min((dist(c,p) for p in pts),default=1e9)
              if d>bd: bd=d;best=c
          pts.append(best)
      return pts
  res={}
  for side,seed in (("left",21),("right",42)):
      pts=mitchell(seed,26)
      r=random.Random(seed+7)
      cols=[]
      for i,p in enumerate(pts): cols.append("Y" if i%2==0 else "L")
      res[side]=[(x,y,c,i) for i,((x,y),c) in enumerate(zip(pts,cols))]
      for t in (8,16,26):
          sub=sorted(res[side][:t],key=lambda p:p[1])
          print(side,t,[(x,y) for x,y,c,i in sub])
  json.dump(res,open("/private/tmp/claude-501/t018work/stars.json","w"))

  import json
  d=json.load(open("/private/tmp/claude-501/t018work/stars.json"))
  groups=(("a",0,8),("b",8,16),("c",16,26))
  name={"Y":"var(--star-yellow)","L":"var(--star-lilac)"}
  def side(sel,extra,pts):
      out=[f"  {sel} {{",f"    {extra}"]
      for g,s,e in groups:
          sub=sorted(pts[s:e],key=lambda p:p[1])

     of the content column. Each margin is a layer beside .site-main, so stars are never beside
     the header or the footer. A star is a 3 px background tile: x in % of the margin width
